List<Table> tables;\n    private final List<JoinPred> preds;\n    private final Estimator estimator;\n\n    private final int full;\n    private final PlanNode[] best;\n    private final double[] bestCost;\n\n    public Optimizer(List<Table> tables, List<JoinPred> preds) {\n        if (tables.isEmpty()) throw new IllegalArgumentException(\"至少需要 1 张表\");\n        if (tables.size() > MAX_TABLES) {\n            throw new IllegalArgumentException(\"最多支持 \" + MAX_TABLES + \" 张表，当前 \"\n                    + tables.size() + \" 张\");\n        }\n        this.tables = tables;\n        this.preds = & -mask;                 // 最低位\n        PlanNode winner = null;\n        double winnerCost = Double.POSITIVE_INFINITY;\n        String winnerCanonical = null;\n\n        int rest = mask ^ lowest;\n estimator.estimate(leftMask), estimator.estimate(rightMask),\n                    leftMask, rightMask, crossing);\n            double nodeCost = PlanNode.nodeCost(\n                    cartesian ? joinopt;\n\nimport java.util.ArrayList;\nimport java.util.Arrays;\nimport java.util.List;\n\n/**\n * 连接顺序动态规划优化器（System R 风格自底向上子集 DP）。\n *\n * <h2>状态定义</h2>\n * 表集合用位掩码表示（最多 8 张表，2^8=256 个子集）。\n * 当等值谓词构成的图存在多个连通分量时，分量之间没有任何等值谓词，\n * 任何完整计划都必然包含笛卡尔积节点。DP 不会报错——它会枚举这些分区\n * 并把对应节点标记为 cartesian=true；由于笛卡尔积代价为 |L|×|R|，\n * 优化器会自动把分量之间的笛卡尔积推迟到最后（最小中间结果原则）。\n *\n * <h2>语义不变性</h2>\n * 估计只影响代价与顺序选择；所有计划（含笛卡尔积计划）表达的关系代数语义相同，\n * 执行器对任意合法顺序产生完全一致的结果行集合（见 Executor 与穷举测试）。\n */\npublic final class Optimizer {\n\n    public static final int MAX_TABLES = 8;\n\n    private final List<Table> tables;\n    private final List<JoinPred> preds;\n    private final Estimator estimator;\n\n    private final int full;\n    private final PlanNode[] best;\n    private final double[] bestCost;\n\n    public Optimizer(List<Table> tables, List<JoinPred> preds) {\n        if (tables.isEmpty()) throw new IllegalArgumentException(\"至少需要 1 张表\");\n        if (tables.size() > MAX_TABLES) preds;\n        this.estimator = new Estimator(tables, preds);\n        this.full = (1 << tables.size()) - 1;\n        this.best = new PlanNode[full + 1];\n        this.bestCost = new double[full + 1];\n        solve();\n    }\n\n    private void solve() {\n        int n = tables.size();\n        // 单表\n        for (int t = 0; t < n; t++) {\n            int mask = 1 << t;\n            PlanNode leaf = PlanNode.leaf(t, tables.get(t).rowCount);\n            leaf.estRows = tables.get(t).rowCount;\n            leaf.cost = 0;\n            best[mask] = leaf;\n            bestCost[mask] = 0;\n              best[mask] = buildBest(mask);\n                bestCost[mask] = best[mask].cost;\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    private PlanNode buildBest(int mask) {\n        int lowest = mask & -mask;                 // 最低位\n        PlanNode winner = null;\n        double winnerCost = Double.POSITIVE_INFINITY;\n        String winnerCanonical = null;\n\n        int rest = mask ^ lowest;\n boolean cartesian = crossing.isEmpty();\n\n            // 子节点朝向确定化：包含更小表编号的放左侧（不影响对称代价）\n            if (minTable(leftMask) > minTable(rightMask)) {\n                PlanNode tp = l; int tm = estimator.estimate(leftMask), estimator.estimate(rightMask),\n                    leftMask, rightMask, crossing);\n            double nodeCost = PlanNode.nodeCost(\n                    cartesian ? PlanNode.CARTESIAN : PlanNode.HASH_JOIN,\n                    l.estRows, r.estRows, outRows);\n            double total = l.cost + r.cost + nodeCost;\n\n            PlanNode candidate = PlanNode.join(cartesian, mask, crossing, l, r, outRows, total);\n            if (total < winnerCost\n                    || (total == winnerCost\n                        && winnerCanonical != null\n                        && candidate.canonical(tables).compareTo(winnerCanonical) < 0)) {\n                winner = candidate;\n                winnerCost = total;\n                winnerCanonical = candidate.canonical(tables);\n            }\n        }\n        if (winner == null) throw new IllegalStateException(\"DP 未为子集 \" + mask + \" 生成计划\");\n        return winner;\n    }\n\n    private static int minTable(int mask) {\n        return Integer.numberOfTrailingZeros(mask);\n    }\n\n    public PlanNode bestPlan() {\n        return best[full];\n    }\n\n    public Estimator estimator() {\n        return estimator;\n    }\n\n    public List<JoinPred> predicates() {\n        return preds;\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * 等值连接图的连通分量（并查集），按分量中的最小表编号排序。\n     * 结果多于 1 个即说明连接图断开，完整计划必然含笛卡尔积。\n     */\n    public List<Integer> connectedComponents() {\n        int n = tables.size();\n        int[] parent = new int[n];\n        for (int i = 0; {"parentUuid":"88f41735-da67-4085-b1aa-c34470dbdeba","isSidechain":false,"message":{"content":[{"id":"call_ynhg58rj90irwozvj45j607k","input":{"file_path":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp17/b/src/main/java/joinopt/Enumerator.java","content":"package joinopt;\n\nimport java.util.ArrayList;\nimport java.util.LinkedHashMap;\nimport java.util.List;\nimport java.util.Map;\n\n/**\n * 合法连接顺序穷举器（仅用于小规模校验，n ≤ 6）。\n *\n * 递归枚举一个子集 S 的所有<b>二叉连接树</b>：\n * <pre>\n *   |S| = 1 -> 只有扫描叶子\n *   |S| > 1 -> 枚举所有非空真子集 L ⊂ S（L 含 S 最低位），\n *              递归得到 L、R 的全部树，两两组合成一个上层连接节点；\n *              跨 L/R 有等值谓词 -> hashjoin，否则 -> cartesian\n * </pre>\n * 树的总数为 (2n-2)! / (n-1)!（n=6 时 30,240 棵），可在毫秒级穷举完成。\n *\n * 因为 {@link Estimator} 的基数估计与顺序无关，同一掩码的所有候选树根节点\n * estRows 完全相同，差异只来自“哪个中间结果被物化为上层输入”——即代价模型\n * 对树形状的选择。穷举得到的最小代价应与 {@link Optimizer} 的 DP 结果一致。\n */\npublic final class Enumerator {\n\n    public static final int ENUM_LIMIT = 6;\n\n    private final List<Table> tables;\n    private final Estimator estimator;\n\n    public Enumerator(List<Table> tables, List<JoinPred> preds) {\n        this.tables = tables;\n        this.estimator = new Estimator(tables, preds);\n    }\n\n    /** 一个子集的全部合法计划。 */\n    public List<PlanNode> enumerate(int mask) {\n        int n = Integer.bitCount(mask);\n        if (n == 1) {\n            int t = Integer.numberOfTrailingZeros(mask);\n            List<PlanNode> one = new ArrayList<>();\n            PlanNode leaf = PlanNode.leaf(t, tables.get(t).rowCount);\n            leaf.estRows = tables.get(t).rowCount;\n            leaf.cost = 0;\n            one.add(leaf);\n            return one;\n        }\n\n        List<PlanNode> result = new ArrayList<>();\n        int lowest = mask & -mask;\n        int rest = mask ^ lowest;\n        for (int lSub = rest; lSub != 0; lSub = (lSub - 1) & rest) {\n            int leftMask = lowest | lSub;\n            int rightMask = mask ^ leftMask;\n            if (rightMask == 0) continue;\n\n            // 子节点朝向与 DP 保持同一约定：较小表编号在左\n            boolean swap = Integer.numberOfTrailingZeros(leftMask)\n                    > Integer.numberOfTrailingZeros(rightMask);\n            int lm = swap ? rightMask : leftMask;\n            int rm = swap ? leftMask : rightMask;\n\n            List<JoinPred> crossing = estimator.crossingPreds(lm, rm);\n            boolean cartesian = crossing.isEmpty();\n            Stats ls = estimator.estimate(lm);\n            Stats rs = estimator.estimate(rm);\n            double outRows = estimator.joinRows(ls, rs, lm, rm, crossing);\n\n            for (PlanNode l : enumerate(lm)) {\n                for (PlanNode r : enumerate(rm)) {\n                    double nodeCost = PlanNode.nodeCost(\n                            cartesian ? PlanNode.CARTESIAN : PlanNode.HASH_JOIN,\n                            l.estRows, r.estRows, outRows);\n                    PlanNode p = PlanNode.join(cartesian, mask, crossing, l, r,\n                            outRows, l.cost + r.cost + nodeCost);\n                    result.add(p);\n                }\n            }\n        }\n        return result;\n    }\n\n    /** 穷举结果汇总。 */\n    public static final class Report {\n        public final int totalTrees;\n        public final double minCost;\n        public final double maxCost;\n        public final int optimalCount;\n        public final PlanNode anOptimalPlan;\n\n        Report(int totalTrees, double minCost, double maxCost,\n               int optimalCount, PlanNode anOptimalPlan) {\n            this.totalTrees = totalTrees;\n            this.minCost = minCost;\n            this.maxCost = maxCost;\n            this.optimalCount = optimalCount;\n            this.anOptimalPlan = anOptimalPlan;\n        }\n\n        public Map<String, Object> toJson() {\n            Map<String, Object> m = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n            m.put(\"totalTrees\", totalTrees);\n            m.put(\"minCost\", clean(minCost));\n            m.put(\"maxCost\", clean(maxCost));\n            m.put(\"optimalCount\", optimalCount);\n            m.put(\"anOptimalPlan\", anOptimalPlan == null ? null : \"见外层 plan\");\n            return m;\n        }\n\n        private static Object clean(double d) {\n            if (d == Math.rint(d) && !Double.isInfinite(d)) return (long) d;\n            return d;\n        }\n    }\n\n    /** 穷举全部表并汇总最小代价等信息。 */\n    public Report fullReport() {\n        if (tables.size() > ENUM_LIMIT) {\n            throw new IllegalArgumentException(\"穷举仅支持 ≤ \" + ENUM_LIMIT + \" 张表\");\n        }\n        int full = (1 << tables.size()) - 1;\n        List<PlanNode> all = enumerate(full);\n        double min = Double.POSITIVE_INFINITY;\n        double max = Double.NEGATIVE_INFINITY;\n        PlanNode bestOne = null;\n        for (PlanNode p : all) {\n            if (p.cost < min) { min = p.cost; bestOne = p; }\n            if (p.cost > max) max = p.cost;\n        }\n        int ties = 0;\n        for (PlanNode p : all) {\n            if (p.cost == min) ties++;\n        }\n        return new Report(all.size(), min, max, ties, bestOne);\n    }\n\n    /** 二叉连接树总数的理论值 (2n-2)!/(n-1)!，用于和穷举计数对照。 */\n    public static long expectedTreeCount(int n) {\n        long v = 1;\n        for (int k = n; k <= 2 * n - 2; k++) v *= k;\n        return v;\n    }\n}\n"},"name":"Write","type":"tool_use"}],"id":"msg_4aa24e989d4c636a9cdb04d7","model":"auto_model/urm","role":"assistant","stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"type":"message","usage":{"input_tokens":281,"cache_creation_input_tokens":0,"cache_read_input_tokens":54072,"output_tokens":1811,"output_tokens_details":{"thinking_tokens":0},"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"","iterations":[],"speed":"standard"},"stop_details":null},"wireToolInputs":{"call_ynhg58rj90irwozvj45j607k":{"content":"package java.util.ArrayList;\nimport java.util.LinkedHashMap;\nimport java.util.List;\nimport java.util.Map;\n\n/**\n * 合法连接顺序穷举器（仅用于小规模校验，n ≤ 6）。\n *\n * 递归枚举一个子集 S 的所有<b>二叉连接树</b>：\n * <pre>\n *   |S| = 1 -> 只有扫描叶子\n *   |S| > 1 -> 枚举所有非空真子集 L ⊂ S（L 含 S 最低位），\n *              递归得到 L、R 的全部树，两两组合成一个上层连接节点；\n *              跨 L/R 有等值谓词 -> hashjoin，否则 -> cartesian\n * </pre>\n * 树的总数为 (2n-2)! / (n-1)!（n=6 时 30,240 棵），可在毫秒级穷举完成。\n *\n * 因为 {@link Estimator} 的基数估计与顺序无关，同一掩码的所有候选树根节点\n * estRows 完全相同，差异只来自“哪个中间结果被物化为上层输入”——即代价模型\n * 对树形状的选择。穷举得到的最小代价应与 {@link Optimizer} 的 DP 结果一致。\n */\npublic final class Enumerator {\n\n    public static final int ENUM_LIMIT = 6;\n\n    private final List<Table> tables;\n    private final Estimator estimator;\n\n    public Enumerator(List<Table> tables, List<JoinPred> preds) {\n        this.tables = tables;\n        this.estimator = new Estimator(tables, preds);\n    }\n\n    /** 一个子集的全部合法计划。 */\n    public List<PlanNode> enumerate(int mask) {\n        int n = Integer.bitCount(mask);\n        if (n == 1) {\n            int t = Integer.numberOfTrailingZeros(mask);\n            List<PlanNode> one = new ArrayList<>();\n            PlanNode leaf = PlanNode.leaf(t, tables.get(t).rowCount);\n            leaf.estRows = tables.get(t).rowCount;\n            leaf.cost = 0;\n            one.add(leaf);\n            return one;\n        }\n\n        List<PlanNode> result = new ArrayList<>();\n        int lowest = mask & -mask;\n        int rest = mask ^ lowest;\n        for (int lSub = rest; lSub != 0; lSub = (lSub - 1) & rest) {\n            int leftMask = lowest | lSub;\n            int rightMask = mask ^ leftMask;\n            if (rightMask == 0) continue;\n\n            // 子节点朝向与 DP 保持同一约定：较小表编号在左\n            boolean swap = Integer.numberOfTrailingZeros(leftMask)\n                    > Integer.numberOfTrailingZeros(rightMask);\n            int lm = swap ? rightMask : leftMask;\n            int rm = swap ? leftMask : rightMask;\n\n            List<JoinPred> crossing = estimator.crossingPreds(lm, rm);\n            boolean cartesian = crossing.isEmpty();\n            Stats ls = estimator.estimate(lm);\n            Stats rs = estimator.estimate(rm);\n            double outRows = estimator.joinRows(ls, rs, lm, rm, crossing);\n\n            for (PlanNode l : enumerate(lm)) {\n                for (PlanNode r : enumerate(rm)) {\n                    double nodeCost = PlanNode.nodeCost(\n                            cartesian ? joinopt;\n\nimport java.util.ArrayList;\nimport java.util.LinkedHashMap;\nimport java.util.List;\nimport java.util.Map;\n\n/**\n * 单机内存执行器：按给定 {@link PlanNode} 真实执行连接并物化结果。\n *\n * <ul>\n *   <li>SCAN：直接读取请求中提供的表数据（rows）；</li>\n *   <li>HASH JOIN：以“右子计划建哈希表、左子计划探测”的方式执行\n *       {@link PlanNode#preds} 中全部等值谓词。键的规范化（数字 1 与 1.0 相等、\n *       null 不匹配任何值）与统计侧一致，保证估计与执行口径统一；</li>\n *   <li>CARTESIAN：嵌套循环生成 |L|×|R| 的全部配对（仅在断开的连接图中出现）。</li>\n * </ul>\n *\n * 没有任何投影/过滤算子：输出列 = 两个输入的列拼接，先左后右。\n * 等值连接的<b>语义</b>与顺序无关，因此不同合法计划产生的结果行多重集合一致\n * （行的排列顺序可能不同；本执行器按探测顺序输出）。\n */\npublic final class Executor {\n\n    private final List<Table> tables;\n\n    public Executor(List<Table> tables) {\n        this.tables = tables;\n    }\n\n    public Rel execute(PlanNode plan) {\n        return run(plan);\n    }\n\n    private Rel run(PlanNode node) {\n        if (node.isLeaf()) {\n            Table t = tables.get(node.tableIdx);\n            if (t.statsOnly) {\n                throw new IllegalStateException(\"表 \" + t.name\n                        + \" 只有统计信息（无 rows），无法实际执行\");\n            }\n            List<String> cols = new ArrayList<>();\n            for (int i = 0; i < t.columns.size(); i++) cols.add(t.qualified(i));\n            List<List<Object>> rows = new ArrayList<>(t.rows.size());\n            for (List<Object> r : t.rows) rows.add(new ArrayList<>(r));\n            node.actualRows = rows.size();\n            return new Rel(cols, rows);\n        }\n\n        Rel left = run(node.left);\n        Rel right = run(node.right);\n\n        Rel out;\n        if (node.kind.equals(PlanNode.CARTESIAN)) {\n            out = nestedLoop(left, right);\n        } else {\n            out = hashJoin(left, right, node.preds);\n        }\n        node.actualRows = out.rows.size();\n        return out;\n    }\n\n    private Rel nestedLoop(Rel left, Rel right) {\n        List<String> cols = new ArrayList<>(left.columns.size() + right.columns.size());\n        cols.addAll(left.columns);\n        cols.addAll(right.columns);\n        List<List<Object>> out = new ArrayList<>(left.rows.size() * right.rows.size());\n        for (List<Object> l : left.rows) {\n            for (List<Object> r : right.rows) {\n                List<Object> merged = new ArrayList<>(l.size() + r.size());\n                merged.addAll(l);\n                merged.addAll(r);\n                out.add(merged);\n            }\n        }\n        return new Rel(cols, out);\n    }\n\n    private Rel hashJoin(Rel left, Rel right, List<JoinPred> preds) {\n        int[] lIdx = new int[preds.size()];\n        int[] rIdx = new int[preds.size()];\n        for (int i = 0; i < preds.size(); i++) {\n            JoinPred p = preds.get(i);\n            // 谓词方向是按基表编号定义的，这里要映射到“左子计划/右子计划”两侧\n            boolean predLeftIsLeft = ((nodeMaskHas(node.left, p.leftTable))\n                    && (nodeMaskHas(node.right, p.rightTable)));\n            if (predLeftIsLeft) {\n                lIdx[i] = left.indexOf(tables.get(p.leftTable).name + \".\" + p.leftColumn);\n                rIdx[i] = right.indexOf(tables.get(p.rightTable).name + \".\" + p.rightColumn);\n            } else {\n                lIdx[i] = left.indexOf(tables.get(p.rightTable).name + \".\" + p.rightColumn);\n                rIdx[i] = right.indexOf(tables.get(p.leftTable).name + \".\" + p.leftColumn);\n            }\n        }\n\n        // 右表建哈希：复合键 -> 数据行列表\n        Map<String, List<List<Object>>> table = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n        for (List<Object> r : right.rows) {\n            if (hasNull(r, rIdx)) continue; // SQL 语义：NULL 不参与等值匹配\n            String key = Rel.keyOf(r, rIdx);\n            table.computeIfAbsent(key, k -> new ArrayList<>()).add(r);\n        }\n\n        List<String> cols = new ArrayList<>(left.columns.size() + right.columns.size());\n        cols.addAll(left.columns);\n        cols.addAll(right.columns);\n        List<List<Object>> out = new ArrayList<>();\n\n        for (List<Object> l : left.rows) {\n            if (hasNull(l, lIdx)) continue;\n            List<List<Object>> matches = table.get(Rel.keyOf(l, lIdx));\n            if (matches == null) continue;\n            for (List<Object> r : matches) {\n                List<Object> merged = new ArrayList<>(l.size() + r.size());\n                merged.addAll(l);\n                merged.addAll(r);\n                out.add(merged);\n            }\n        }\n        return new Rel(cols, out);\n    }\n\n    private static boolean nodeMaskHas(PlanNode n, int tableIdx) {\n        return ((n.mask >>> tableIdx) & 1) == 1;\n    }\n\n    private static boolean hasNull(List<Object> row, int[] idxs) {\n        for (int i : idxs) if (row.get(i) == null) return true;\n        return false;\n    }\n}\n"},"name":"Write","type":"tool_use"}],"id":"msg_7e2bde553c5e8948cd1e02ae","model":"auto_model/urm","role":"assistant","stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"type":"message","usage":{"input_tokens":825,"cache_creation_input_tokens":0,"cache_read_input_tokens":57144,"output_tokens":1445,"output_tokens_details":{"thinking_tokens":0},"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"","iterations":[],"speed":"standard"},"stop_details":null},"wireToolInputs":{"call_6c3pgv100eb7ttziw1kp7ue5":{"content":"package (file state is current in your context — no need to Read it back)"}]},"uuid":"898e09dc-e657-4cbd-b25a-311aa74b3d9a","timestamp":"2026-09-23T03:14:58.969Z","toolUseResult":{"filePath":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp17/b/src/main/java/joinopt/Executor.java","oldString":"    private Rel hashJoin(Rel left, Rel right, List<JoinPred> preds) {\n        int[] lIdx = new int[preds.size()];","newString":"    private Rel hashJoin(PlanNode node, Rel left, Rel right) {\n        List<JoinPred> preds = node.preds;\n        int[] lIdx = new int[preds.size()];","originalFile":"package joinopt;\n\nimport java.util.ArrayList;\nimport java.util.LinkedHashMap;\nimport java.util.List;\nimport java.util.Map;\n\n/**\n * 单机内存执行器：按给定 {@link PlanNode} 真实执行连接并物化结果。\n *\n * <ul>\n *   <li>SCAN：直接读取请求中提供的表数据（rows）；</li>\n *   <li>HASH JOIN：以“右子计划建哈希表、左子计划探测”的方式执行\n *       {@link PlanNode#preds} 中全部等值谓词。键的规范化（数字 1 与 1.0 相等、\n *       null 不匹配任何值）与统计侧一致，保证估计与执行口径统一；</li>\n *   <li>CARTESIAN：嵌套循环生成 |L|×|R| 的全部配对（仅在断开的连接图中出现）。</li>\n * </ul>\n *\n * 没有任何投影/过滤算子：输出列 = 两个输入的列拼接，先左后右。\n * 等值连接的<b>语义</b>与顺序无关，因此不同合法计划产生的结果行多重集合一致\n * （行的排列顺序可能不同；本执行器按探测顺序输出）。\n */\npublic final class Executor {\n\n    private final List<Table> tables;\n\n    public Executor(List<Table> tables) {\n        this.tables = tables;\n    }\n\n    public Rel execute(PlanNode plan) {\n        return run(plan);\n    }\n\n    private Rel run(PlanNode node) {\n        if (node.isLeaf()) {\n            Table t = tables.get(node.tableIdx);\n            if (t.statsOnly) {\n                throw new IllegalStateException(\"表 \" + t.name\n                        + \" 只有统计信息（无 rows），无法实际执行\");\n            }\n            List<String> cols = new ArrayList<>();\n            for (int i = 0; i < t.columns.size(); i++) cols.add(t.qualified(i));\n            List<List<Object>> rows = new ArrayList<>(t.rows.size());\n            for (List<Object> r : t.rows) rows.add(new ArrayList<>(r));\n            node.actualRows = rows.size();\n            return new Rel(cols, rows);\n        }\n\n        Rel left = run(node.left);\n        Rel right = run(node.right);\n\n        Rel out;\n        if (node.kind.equals(PlanNode.CARTESIAN)) {\n            out = nestedLoop(left, right);\n        } else {\n            out = hashJoin(node, left, right);\n        }\n        node.actualRows = out.rows.size();\n        return out;\n    }\n\n    private Rel nestedLoop(Rel left, Rel right) {\n        List<String> cols = new ArrayList<>(left.columns.size() + right.columns.size());\n        cols.addAll(left.columns);\n        cols.addAll(right.columns);\n        List<List<Object>> out = new ArrayList<>(left.rows.size() * right.rows.size());\n        for (List<Object> l : left.rows) {\n            for (List<Object> r : right.rows) {\n                List<Object> merged = new ArrayList<>(l.size() + r.size());\n                merged.addAll(l);\n                merged.addAll(r);\n                out.add(merged);\n            }\n        }\n        return new Rel(cols, out);\n    }\n\n    private Rel hashJoin(Rel left, Rel right, List<JoinPred> preds) {\n        int[] lIdx = new int[preds.size()];\n        int[] rIdx = new int[preds.size()];\n        for (int i = 0; i < preds.size(); i++) {\n            JoinPred p = preds.get(i);\n            // 谓词方向是按基表编号定义的，这里要映射到“左子计划/右子计划”两侧\n            boolean predLeftIsLeft = ((nodeMaskHas(node.left, p.leftTable))\n                    && (nodeMaskHas(node.right, p.rightTable)));\n            if (predLeftIsLeft) {\n                lIdx[i] = left.indexOf(tables.get(p.leftTable).name + \".\" + p.leftColumn);\n                rIdx[i] = right.indexOf(tables.get(p.rightTable).name + \".\" + p.rightColumn);\n            } else {\n                lIdx[i] = left.indexOf(tables.get(p.rightTable).name + \".\" + p.rightColumn);\n                rIdx[i] = right.indexOf(tables.get(p.leftTable).name + \".\" + p.leftColumn);\n            }\n        }\n\n        // 右表建哈希：复合键 -> 数据行列表\n        Map<String, List<List<Object>>> table = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n        for (List<Object> r : right.rows) {\n            if (hasNull(r, rIdx)) continue; // SQL 语义：NULL 不参与等值匹配\n            String key = Rel.keyOf(r, rIdx);\n            table.computeIfAbsent(key, k -> new ArrayList<>()).add(r);\n        }\n\n        List<String> cols = new ArrayList<>(left.columns.size() + right.columns.size());\n        cols.addAll(left.columns);\n        cols.addAll(right.columns);\n        List<List<Object>> out = new ArrayList<>();\n\n        for (List<Object> l : left.rows) {\n            if (hasNull(l, lIdx)) continue;\n            List<List<Object>> matches = table.get(Rel.keyOf(l, lIdx));\n            if (matches == null) continue;\n            for (List<Object> r : matches) {\n                List<Object> merged = new ArrayList<>(l.size() + r.size());\n                merged.addAll(l);\n                merged.addAll(r);\n                out.add(merged);\n            }\n        }\n        return new Rel(cols, out);\n    }\n\n    private static boolean nodeMaskHas(PlanNode n, int tableIdx) {\n        return ((n.mask >>> tableIdx) & 1) == 1;\n    }\n\n    private static boolean hasNull(List<Object> row, int[] idxs) {\n        for (int i : idxs) if (row.get(i) == null) return true;\n        return false;\n    }\n}\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":76,"oldLines":7,"newStart":76,"newLines":8,"lines":["         return new Rel(cols, out);","     }"," ","-    private Rel hashJoin(Rel left, Rel right, List<JoinPred> preds) {","+    private Rel hashJoin(PlanNode node, Rel left, Rel right) {","+        List<JoinPred> preds = node.preds;","         int[] lIdx = new int[preds.size()];","         int[] rIdx = new int[preds.size()];","         for (int i = 0; i < preds.size(); i++) {"]}],"userModified":false,"replaceAll":false},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"c240bbf5-558f-473e-b205-2a40bfad3249","session_id":"90b11851-b85c-4121-bed4-1de860a4594d","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp17/b","sessionId":"90b11851-b85c-4121-bed4-1de860a4594d","version":"2.1.280","gitBranch":"ab/run-20260922T151547Z/opp17-b","slug":"streamed-doodling-badger"}

joinopt;\n\nimport java.io.IOException;\nimport java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;\nimport java.nio.file.Files;\nimport java.nio.file.Path;\nimport java.util.ArrayList;\nimport java.util.LinkedHashMap;\nimport java.util.List;\nimport java.util.Map;\n\n/**\n * 命令行 / JSON 请求入口。\n *\n * 用法：\n * <pre>\n *   java -cp build/classes joinopt.Main request.json [--export-dir DIR]\n *   cat request.json | java -cp build/classes joinopt.Main -\n * </pre>\n * 标准输出为响应 JSON（见 README 的“请求/响应格式”）。\n * --export-dir DIR 时额外导出 plan.json / data.json / plan.txt / request.json。\n * 任何错误以 exit code=1 + {\"error\":...} 返回，不输出堆栈给调用方。\n */\npublic final class Main {\n\n    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {\n        Path requestFile = null;\n        Path exportDir = null;\n        for (int i = 0; i < args.length; i++) {\n            String a = args[i];\n            if (\"--export-dir\".equals(a)) {\n                if (i + 1 >= args.length) fail(\"--export-dir 缺少目录参数\");\n                exportDir = Path.of(args[++i]);\n            } else if (a.startsWith(\"--export-dir=\")) {\n                exportDir = Path.of(a.substring(\"--export-dir=\".length()));\n            } else if (\"-\".equals(a)) {\n                requestFile = null;\n            } else if (a.startsWith(\"-\")) {\n                fail(\"未知参数: \" + a);\n            } else {\n                requestFile = Path.of(a);\n            }\n        }\n\n        String text;\n        if (requestFile != null) {\n            if (!Files.exists(requestFile)) fail(\"请求文件不存在: \" + requestFile);\n            text = Files.readString(requestFile, StandardCharsets.UTF_8);\n        } else {\n            text = new String(System.in.readAllBytes(), StandardCharsets.UTF_8);\n        }\n\n        try {\n            Object parsed = Json.parse(text);\n            Map<String, Object> resp = new Handler().handle(Json.asObj(parsed), exportDir);\n            System.out.println(Json.pretty(resp));\n        } catch (Exception e) {\n            fail(e.getMessage() == null ? e.toString() : e.getMessage());\n        }\n    }\n\n    private static void fail(String msg) {\n        Map<String, Object> err = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n        err.put(\"error\", msg);\n        System.err.println(Json.pretty(err));\n        System.exit(1);\n    }\n\n    /** 请求处理器（独立成 public 类方法，方便自动化测试直接调用）。 */\n    public static final class Handler {\n\n        public Map<String, Object> handle(Map<String, Object> req, Path exportDir) throws IOException {\n            List<String> warnings = new ArrayList<>();\n\n            // ---- 解析表 ----\n            List<Object> tablesJson = Json.arr(req, \"tables\");\n            if (tablesJson == null || tablesJson.isEmpty()) {\n                throw new IllegalArgumentException(\"请求缺少 tables 或 tables 为空\");\n            }\n            List<Table> tables = new ArrayList<>();\n            Map<String, Integer> nameToIdx = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n            for (Object tj : tablesJson) {\n                Table t = Table.fromJson(Json.asObj(tj), warnings);\n                if (nameToIdx.containsKey(t.name)) {\n                    throw new IllegalArgumentException(\"表名重复: \" + t.name);\n                }\n                nameToIdx.put(t.name, tables.size());\n                tables.add(t);\n            }\n            if (tables.size() > Optimizer.MAX_TABLES) {\n                throw new IllegalArgumentException(\"最多支持 \" + Optimizer.MAX_TABLES + \" 张表，当前 \"\n                        + tables.size() + \" 张\");\n            }\n\n            // ---- 解析谓词 ----\n            List<JoinPred> preds = new ArrayList<>();\n            List<Object> joinsJson = Json.arr(req, \"joins\");\n            if (joinsJson != null) {\n                for (int i = 0; i < joinsJson.size(); i++) {\n                    JoinPred p = JoinPred.fromJson(joinsJson.get(i), nameToIdx, \"#\" + (i + 1));\n                    // 校验列存在，并顺便确认不是重复边\n                    tables.get(p.leftTable).colIndex(p.leftColumn);\n                    tables.get(p.rightTable).colIndex(p.rightColumn);\n                    preds.add(p);\n                }\n            }\n            if (joinsJson == null) {\n                warnings.add(\"请求未提供 joins，\" + tables.size() + \" 张表将全部做笛卡尔积\");\n            }\n\n            // ---- 选项 ----\n            Map<String, Object> opt = req.get(\"options\") instanceof Map\n                    ? Json.asObj(req.get(\"options\")) : new LinkedHashMap<>();\n            boolean wantExec = boolOpt(opt, \"execute\", true);\n            boolean wantEnum = boolOpt(opt, \"enumerate\", false);\n            long limit = opt.containsKey(\"resultLimit\") ? Json.lng(opt, \"resultLimit\") : 20L;\n            if (limit < 0) limit = 20;\n\n            // ---- 优化 ----\n            Optimizer optimizer = new Optimizer(tables, preds);\n            PlanNode plan = optimizer.bestPlan();\n\n            List<Integer> components = optimizer.connectedComponents();\n            boolean cartesian = Optimizer.containsCartesian(plan);\n            if (components.size() > 1) {\n                warnings.add(\"连接图不连通：有 \" + components.size()\n                        + \" 个连通分量，完整计划包含笛卡尔积（已在计划中标记 cartesian=true）\");\n            }\n\n            // ---- 可选：穷举校验 ----\n            Map<String, Object> enumJson = null;\n            if (wantEnum) {\n                if (tables.size() > Enumerator.ENUM_LIMIT) {\n                    warnings.add(\"表数量 > \" + Enumerator.ENUM_LIMIT\n                            + \"，已跳过穷举（计划仍由 DP 给出）\");\n                } else {\n                    Enumerator en = new Enumerator(tables, preds);\n                    Enumerator.Report report = en.fullReport();\n                    enumJson = report.toJson();\n                    enumJson.put(\"expectedTreeCount\",\n                            Enumerator.expectedTreeCount(tables.size()));\n                    enumJson.put(\"dpCost\", clean(plan.cost));\n                    if (report.minCost != plan.cost) {\n                        throw new IllegalStateException(\"校验失败：穷举最小代价 \" + report.minCost\n                                + \" 与 DP 代价 \" + plan.cost + \" 不一致\");\n                    }\n                    enumJson.put(\"matchesDp\", true);\n                }\n            }\n\n            // ---- 可选：实际执行 ----\n            Map<String, Object> resultJson = null;\n            Rel result = null;\n            boolean executed = false;\n            if (wantExec) {\n                List<String> missing = new ArrayList<>();\n                for (Table t : tables) if (t.statsOnly) missing.add(t.name);\n                if (!missing.isEmpty()) {\n                    warnings.add(\"以下表仅有统计信息，跳过实际执行: \" + missing);\n                } else {\n                    result = new Executor(tables).execute(plan);\n                    executed = true;\n                    resultJson = buildResultJson(plan, result, limit);\n                }\n            }\n\n            // ---- 组装响应 ----\n            Map<String, Object> resp = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n            resp.put(\"ok\", true);\n            resp.put(\"summary\", buildSummary(tables, preds, components, plan, executed));\n            resp.put(\"plan\", plan.toJson(tables));\n            resp.put(\"planText\", plan.toText(tables).stripTrailing());\n            if (enumJson != null) resp.put(\"enumeration\", enumJson);\n            if (resultJson != null) resp.put(\"result\", resultJson);\n            resp.put(\"subsets\", buildSubsets(tables, optimizer));\n            resp.put(\"warnings\", warnings);\n\n            // ---- 导出 ----\n            if (exportDir != null) {\n                export(exportDir, req, tables, plan, optimizer, result);\n                resp.put(\"exportedTo\", exportDir.toAbsolutePath().toString());\n            }\n            return resp;\n        }\n\n        private static boolean boolOpt(Map<String, Object> opt, String key, boolean def) {\n            if (!opt.containsKey(key) || opt.get(key) == null) return def;\n            Object v = opt.get(key);\n            if (v instanceof Boolean) return (Boolean) v;\n            return Boolean.parseBoolean(String.valueOf(v));\n        }\n\n        private static Map<String, Object> buildSummary(List<Table> tables, List<JoinPred> preds,\n                                                        List<Integer> components, PlanNode plan,\n                                                        boolean executed) {\n            Map<String, Object> s = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n            s.put(\"tableCount\", tables.size());\n            s.put(\"joinPredicateCount\", preds.size());\n            List<Object> comps = new ArrayList<>();\n            for (int mask : components) comps.add(maskNames(mask, tables));\n            s.put(\"connectedComponents\", comps);\n            s.put(\"connected\", components.size() == 1);\n            s.put(\"containsCartesian\", Optimizer.containsCartesian(plan));\n            s.put(\"estRows\", plan.rounded());\n            s.put(\"totalCost\", clean(plan.cost));\n            if (executed) {\n                s.put(\"actualRows\", plan.actualRows);\n                s.put(\"estimateError\",\n                        plan.actualRows == 0 ? null\n                                : clean((double) (plan.rounded() - plan.actualRows) / plan.actualRows));\n            }\n            return s;\n        }\n\n        private static List<String> maskNames(int mask, List<Table> tables) {\n            List<String> names = new ArrayList<>();\n            for (int i = 0; i < tables.size(); i++) {\n                if (((mask >>> i) & 1) == 1) names.add(tables.get(i).name);\n            }\n            return names;\n        }\n\n        private static Map<String, Object> {"parentUuid":"ef3f5fbd-d09b-41d2-8552-ae8724477e51","isSidechain":false,"message":{"content":[{"id":"call_y0kw0cx4fs8k11vxj4wrhei3","input":{"file_path":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp17/b/scripts/gen_samples.py","content":"#!/usr/bin/env python3\n# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-\n\"\"\"\n生成两个请求样本：\n  samples/skew3.json —— 3 张表带倾斜数据，展示“均匀假设估计行数 vs 实际行数”的差异\n  samples/star8.json —— 8 张表星型连接（仅统计），展示 DP 在表数上限下的选序\n\n用法：python3 scripts/gen_samples.py\n\"\"\"\nimport json\nimport os\n\nROOT = os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))\nSAMPLES = os.path.join(ROOT, \"samples\")\n\n\ndef make_skew3(n=100, hot_share=0.90, hot_key=1):\n    \"\"\"\n    三张表 t1/t2/t3 各 n 行，连接键 k 有 m=n/10 个不同值，\n    其中 hot_key 占 90% 的行（倾斜），其余 9 个键各占 10%/9。\n    均匀假设按 NDV 估计选择率 1/m，严重低估热点键产生的连接行数。\n    \"\"\"\n    m = n // 10\n    other = n - int(n * hot_share)          # 非热点键总行数\n    per_other = other // (m - 1)            # 每个非热点键的行数\n\n    def rows():\n        data = [hot_key] * (n - per_other * (m - 1))\n        for k in range(2, m + 1):\n            data += [k] * per_other\n        assert len(data) == n\n        return [[v] for v in data]\n\n    def ndv_and_counts(data):\n        counts = {}\n        for (v,) in data:\n            counts[v] = counts.get(v, 0) + 1\n        return len(counts), counts\n\n    r1, r2, r3 = rows(), rows(), rows()\n    ndv, c1 = ndv_and_counts(r1)\n    _, c2 = ndv_and_counts(r2)\n    _, c3 = ndv_and_counts(r3)\n\n    # 实际两表连接行数 = Σ count1(k)*count2(k)\n    actual_2way = sum(c1[k] * c2[k] for k in c1)\n    actual_3way = sum(c1[k] * c2[k] * c3[k] for k in c1)\n    est_2way = n * n // ndv\n    est_3way = n ** 3 // ndv ** 2\n\n    req = {\n        \"comment\": (\n            \"倾斜统计实验：t1/t2/t3 各 %d 行，键 k 有 %d 个不同值，\"\n            \"键 %d 占 %.0f%% 的行。均匀假设估计两表连接=%d、三表=%d；\"\n            \"实际两表=%d、三表=%d（见响应 estimateVsActual）。\"\n        ) % (n, ndv, hot_key, hot_share * 100, est_2way, est_3way,\n             actual_2way, actual_3way),\n        \"tables\": [\n            {\"name\": \"t1\", \"columns\": [\"k\"], \"rows\": r1},\n            {\"name\": \"t2\", \"columns\": [\"k\"], \"rows\": r2},\n            {\"name\": \"t3\", \"columns\": [\"k\"], \"rows\": r3},\n        ],\n        \"joins\": [\n            [\"t1\", \"k\", \"t2\", \"k\"],\n            [\"t2\", \"k\", \"t3\", \"k\"],\n        ],\n        \"options\": {\"execute\": True, \"enumerate\": True, \"resultLimit\": 3},\n    }\n\n    print(\"skew3: n=%d ndv=%d hotKey=%d hotRows/table=%d\"\n          % (n, ndv, hot_key, c1[hot_key]))\n    print(\"  2-way  est=%d actual=%d  ratio=%.2f\"\n          % (est_2way, actual_2way, actual_2way / est_2way))\n    print(\"  3-way  est=%d actual=%d  ratio=%.2f\"\n          % (est_3way, actual_3way, actual_3way / est_3way))\n    return req\n\n\ndef make_star8():\n    \"\"\"\n    8 表星型：大事实表 f（100 万行）+ 7 个维度表 d1..d7（主键 1..|di|）。\n    仅统计，不实际执行。演示 DP 在 8 表（255 个子集）下的枚举与选序。\n    \"\"\"\n    dim_sizes = [10, 50, 100, 500, 1000, 5000, 10000]\n    fact_rows = 1_000_000\n    tables = [{\n        \"name\": \"f\",\n        \"columns\": [\"id\"] + [\"d%d_id\" % i for i in range(1, 8)],\n        \"rowCount\": fact_rows,\n        \"ndv\": {\"id\": fact_rows, **{\n            \"d%d_id\" % i: dim_sizes[i - 1] for i in range(1, 8)\n        }},\n    }]\n    joins = []\n    for i, size in enumerate(dim_sizes, start=1):\n        tables.append({\n            \"name\": \"d%d\" % i,\n            \"columns\": [\"id\"],\n            \"rowCount\": size,\n            \"ndv\": {\"id\": size},\n        })\n        joins.append([\"f\", \"d%d_id\" % i, \"d%d\" % i, \"id\"])\n\n    return {\n        \"comment\": \"8 表星型连接（上限）：事实表 f(1,000,000) + 7 个维度表，仅统计\",\n        \"tables\": tables,\n        \"joins\": joins,\n        \"options\": {\"execute\": False, \"enumerate\": False, \"resultLimit\": 0},\n    }\n\n\ndef main():\n    os.makedirs(SAMPLES, exist_ok=True)\n    skew = make_skew3()\n    with open(os.path.join(SAMPLES, \"skew3.json\"), \"w\", encoding=\"utf-8\") as f:\n        json.dump(skew, f, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)\n        f.write(\"\\n\")\n    star = make_star8()\n    with open(os.path.join(SAMPLES, \"star8.json\"), \"w\", encoding=\"utf-8\") as f:\n        json.dump(star, f, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)\n        f.write(\"\\n\")\n    print(\"wrote samples/skew3.json and samples/star8.json\")\n\n\nif __name__ == \"__main__\":\n    main()\n"},"name":"Write","type":"tool_use"}],"id":"msg_8bf3f5219a65e8df2d8d763e","model":"auto_model/urm","role":"assistant","stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"type":"message","usage":{"input_tokens":459,"cache_creation_input_tokens":0,"cache_read_input_tokens":64312,"output_tokens":1959,"output_tokens_details":{"thinking_tokens":0},"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"","iterations":[],"speed":"standard"},"stop_details":null},"wireToolInputs":{"call_y0kw0cx4fs8k11vxj4wrhei3":{"content":"#!/usr/bin/env winner;","originalFile":"package joinopt;\n\nimport java.util.ArrayList;\nimport java.util.Arrays;\nimport java.util.List;\n\n/**\n * 连接顺序动态规划优化器（System R 风格自底向上子集 DP）。\n *\n * <h2>状态定义</h2>\n * 表集合用位掩码表示（最多 8 张表，2^8=256 个子集）。\n * best[mask] = 覆盖该子集的、累计估计代价最小的 {@link PlanNode}。\n *\n * <h2>转移</h2>\n * 对每个子集 S，枚举其所有真子分区 (L, R)（令 L 包含 S 的最低位，\n * 以避免同一分区的重复枚举）：\n * <pre>\n *   crossing = 跨越 L、R 的等值谓词\n *   无 crossing -> 笛卡尔积（NESTEDLOOP）\n *   有 crossing -> 等值哈希连接（一次应用全部跨分区谓词）\n *   cost(S) = cost(L) + cost(R) + nodeCost(本节点)\n * </pre>\n * 取所有分区中代价最小者；代价相同按计划规范串字典序打破平局，保证结果确定。\n *\n * <h2>断开的连接图</h2>\n * 当等值谓词构成的图存在多个连通分量时，分量之间没有任何等值谓词，\n * 任何完整计划都必然包含笛卡尔积节点。DP 不会报错——它会枚举这些分区\n * 并把对应节点标记为 cartesian=true；由于笛卡尔积代价为 |L|×|R|，\n * 优化器会自动把分量之间的笛卡尔积推迟到最后（最小中间结果原则）。\n *\n * <h2>语义不变性</h2>\n * 估计只影响代价与顺序选择；所有计划（含笛卡尔积计划）表达的关系代数语义相同，\n * 执行器对任意合法顺序产生完全一致的结果行集合（见 Executor 与穷举测试）。\n */\npublic final class Optimizer {\n\n    public static final int MAX_TABLES = 8;\n\n    private final List<Table> tables;\n    private final List<JoinPred> preds;\n    private final Estimator estimator;\n\n    private final int full;\n    private final PlanNode[] best;\n    private final double[] bestCost;\n\n    public Optimizer(List<Table> tables, List<JoinPred> preds) {\n        if (tables.isEmpty()) throw new IllegalArgumentException(\"至少需要 1 张表\");\n        if (tables.size() > MAX_TABLES) {\n            throw new IllegalArgumentException(\"最多支持 \" + MAX_TABLES + \" 张表，当前 \"\n                    + tables.size() + \" 张\");\n        }\n        this.tables = tables;\n        this.preds = preds;\n        this.estimator = new Estimator(tables, preds);\n        this.full = (1 << tables.size()) - 1;\n        this.best = new PlanNode[full + 1];\n        this.bestCost = new double[full + 1];\n        solve();\n    }\n\n    private void solve() {\n        int n = tables.size();\n        // 单表\n        for (int t = 0; t < n; t++) {\n            int mask = 1 << t;\n            PlanNode leaf = PlanNode.leaf(t, tables.get(t).rowCount);\n            leaf.estRows = tables.get(t).rowCount;\n            leaf.cost = 0;\n            best[mask] = leaf;\n            bestCost[mask] = 0;\n        }\n        // 多表子集：按子集大小递增\n        for (int size = 2; size <= n; size++) {\n            for (int mask = 1; mask <= full; mask++) {\n                if (Integer.bitCount(mask) != size) continue;\n                best[mask] = buildBest(mask);\n                bestCost[mask] = best[mask].cost;\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    private PlanNode buildBest(int mask) {\n        int lowest = mask & -mask;                 // 最低位\n        PlanNode winner = null;\n        double winnerCost = Double.POSITIVE_INFINITY;\n        String winnerCanonical = null;\n\n        int rest = mask ^ lowest;\n        for (int lSub = rest; lSub != 0; lSub = (lSub - 1) & rest) {\n            int leftMask = lowest | lSub;\n            int rightMask = mask ^ leftMask;\n            if (rightMask == 0) continue;\n\n            PlanNode l = best[leftMask];\n            PlanNode r = best[rightMask];\n            List<JoinPred> crossing = estimator.crossingPreds(leftMask, rightMask);\n            boolean cartesian = crossing.isEmpty();\n\n            // 子节点朝向确定化：包含更小表编号的放左侧（不影响对称代价）\n            if (minTable(leftMask) > minTable(rightMask)) {\n                PlanNode tp = l; int tm = leftMask;\n                l = r; r = tp;\n                leftMask = rightMask; rightMask = tm;\n            }\n\n            double outRows = estimator.joinRows(\n                    estimator.estimate(leftMask), estimator.estimate(rightMask),\n                    leftMask, rightMask, crossing);\n            double nodeCost = PlanNode.nodeCost(\n                    cartesian ? PlanNode.CARTESIAN : PlanNode.HASH_JOIN,\n                    l.estRows, r.estRows, outRows);\n            double total = l.cost + r.cost + nodeCost;\n\n            PlanNode candidate = PlanNode.join(cartesian, mask, crossing, l, r, outRows, total);\n            if (total < winnerCost\n                    || (total == winnerCost\n                        && winnerCanonical != null\n                        && candidate.canonical(tables).compareTo(winnerCanonical) < 0)) {\n                winner = candidate;\n                winnerCost = total;\n                winnerCanonical = candidate.canonical(tables);\n            }\n        }\n        if (winner == null) throw new IllegalStateException(\"DP 未为子集 \" + mask + \" 生成计划\");\n        return winner;\n    }\n\n    private static int minTable(int mask) {\n        return Integer.numberOfTrailingZeros(mask);\n    }\n\n    public PlanNode bestPlan() {\n        return best[full];\n    }\n\n    public Estimator estimator() {\n        return estimator;\n    }\n\n    public List<JoinPred> predicates() {\n        return preds;\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * 等值连接图的连通分量（并查集），按分量中的最小表编号排序。\n     * 结果多于 1 个即说明连接图断开，完整计划必然含笛卡尔积。\n     */\n    public List<Integer> connectedComponents() {\n        int n = tables.size();\n        int[] parent = new int[n];\n        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) parent[i] = i;\n        for (JoinPred p : preds) union(parent, p.leftTable, p.rightTable);\n\n        // 根 -> 分量掩码；为保持顺序确定，按表编号递增遇到新分量再建桶\n        int[] maskOfRoot = new int[n];\n        Arrays.fill(maskOfRoot, -1);\n        List<Integer> masks = new ArrayList<>();\n        for (int i = 0; mask ^ lowest;","originalFile":"package joinopt;\n\nimport java.util.ArrayList;\nimport java.util.Arrays;\nimport java.util.List;\n\n/**\n * 连接顺序动态规划优化器（System R 风格自底向上子集 DP）。\n *\n * <h2>状态定义</h2>\n * 表集合用位掩码表示（最多 8 张表，2^8=256 个子集）。\n * best[mask] = 覆盖该子集的、累计估计代价最小的 {@link PlanNode}。\n *\n * <h2>转移</h2>\n * 对每个子集 S，枚举其所有真子分区 (L, R)（令 L 包含 S 的最低位，\n * 以避免同一分区的重复枚举）：\n * <pre>\n *   crossing = 跨越 L、R 的等值谓词\n *   无 crossing -> 笛卡尔积（NESTEDLOOP）\n *   有 crossing -> 等值哈希连接（一次应用全部跨分区谓词）\n *   cost(S) = cost(L) + cost(R) + nodeCost(本节点)\n * </pre>\n * 取所有分区中代价最小者；代价相同按计划规范串字典序打破平局，保证结果确定。\n *\n * <h2>断开的连接图</h2>\n * 当等值谓词构成的图存在多个连通分量时，分量之间没有任何等值谓词，\n * 任何完整计划都必然包含笛卡尔积节点。DP 不会报错——它会枚举这些分区\n * 并把对应节点标记为 cartesian=true；由于笛卡尔积代价为 |L|×|R|，\n * 优化器会自动把分量之间的笛卡尔积推迟到最后（最小中间结果原则）。\n *\n * <h2>语义不变性</h2>\n * 估计只影响代价与顺序选择；所有计划（含笛卡尔积计划）表达的关系代数语义相同，\n * 执行器对任意合法顺序产生完全一致的结果行集合（见 Executor 与穷举测试）。\n */\npublic final class Optimizer {\n\n    public static final int MAX_TABLES = 8;\n\n    private final List<Table> tables;\n    private final List<JoinPred> preds;\n    private final Estimator estimator;\n\n    private final int full;\n    private final PlanNode[] best;\n    private final double[] bestCost;\n\n    public Optimizer(List<Table> tables, List<JoinPred> preds) {\n        if (tables.isEmpty()) throw new IllegalArgumentException(\"至少需要 1 张表\");\n        if (tables.size() > MAX_TABLES) {\n            throw new IllegalArgumentException(\"最多支持 \" + MAX_TABLES + \" 张表，当前 \"\n                    + tables.size() + \" 张\");\n        }\n        this.tables = tables;\n        this.preds = preds;\n        this.estimator = new Estimator(tables, preds);\n        this.full = (1 << tables.size()) - 1;\n        this.best = new PlanNode[full + 1];\n        this.bestCost = new double[full + 1];\n        solve();\n    }\n\n    private void solve() {\n        int n = tables.size();\n        // 单表\n        for (int t = 0; t < n; t++) {\n            int mask = 1 << t;\n            PlanNode leaf = PlanNode.leaf(t, tables.get(t).rowCount);\n            leaf.estRows = tables.get(t).rowCount;\n            leaf.cost = 0;\n            best[mask] = leaf;\n            bestCost[mask] = 0;\n        }\n        // 多表子集：按子集大小递增\n        for (int size = 2; size <= n; size++) {\n            for (int mask = 1; mask <= full; mask++) {\n                if (Integer.bitCount(mask) != size) continue;\n                best[mask] = buildBest(mask);\n                bestCost[mask] = best[mask].cost;\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    private PlanNode buildBest(int mask) {\n        int lowest = mask & -mask;                 // 最低位\n        int rest = mask ^ lowest;\n        for (int lSub = rest; ; lSub = (lSub - 1) & rest) {\n            int leftMask = lowest | lSub;\n            int rightMask = mask ^ leftMask;\n\n            PlanNode l = best[leftMask];\n            PlanNode r = best[rightMask];\n            List<JoinPred> crossing = estimator.crossingPreds(leftMask, rightMask);\n            boolean cartesian = crossing.isEmpty();\n\n            // 子节点朝向确定化：包含更小表编号的放左侧（不影响对称代价）\n            if (minTable(leftMask) > minTable(rightMask)) {\n                PlanNode tp = l; int tm = leftMask;\n                l = r; r = tp;\n                leftMask = rightMask; rightMask = tm;\n            }\n\n            double outRows = estimator.joinRows(\n                    estimator.estimate(leftMask), estimator.estimate(rightMask),\n                    leftMask, rightMask, crossing);\n            double nodeCost = PlanNode.nodeCost(\n                    cartesian ? PlanNode.CARTESIAN : PlanNode.HASH_JOIN,\n                    l.estRows, r.estRows, outRows);\n            double total = l.cost + r.cost + nodeCost;\n\n            PlanNode candidate = PlanNode.join(cartesian, mask, crossing, l, r, outRows, total);\n            if (total < winnerCost\n                    || (total == winnerCost\n                        && winnerCanonical != null\n                        && candidate.canonical(tables).compareTo(winnerCanonical) < 0)) {\n                winner = candidate;\n                winnerCost = total;\n                winnerCanonical = candidate.canonical(tables);\n            }\n            if (lSub == 0) break;\n        }\n        if (winner == null) throw new IllegalStateException(\"DP 未为子集 \" + mask + \" 生成计划\");\n        return winner;\n    }\n\n    private static int minTable(int mask) {\n        return Integer.numberOfTrailingZeros(mask);\n    }\n\n    public PlanNode bestPlan() {\n        return best[full];\n    }\n\n    public Estimator estimator() {\n        return estimator;\n    }\n\n    public List<JoinPred> predicates() {\n        return preds;\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * 等值连接图的连通分量（并查集），按分量中的最小表编号排序。\n     * 结果多于 1 个即说明连接图断开，完整计划必然含笛卡尔积。\n     */\n    public List<Integer> connectedComponents() {\n        int n = tables.size();\n        int[] parent = new int[n];\n        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {\n            int root = find(parent, i);\n            if (maskOfRoot[root] < 0) {\n                maskOfRoot[root] = masks.size();\n                masks.add(0);\n            }\n            masks.set(maskOfRoot[root], masks.get(maskOfRoot[root]) | (1 << i));\n        }\n        masks.sort((a, b) -> Integer.compare(minTable(a), minTable(b)));\n        return masks;\n    }\n\n    private static int find(int[] parent, int x) {\n        while (parent[x] != x) {\n            parent[x] = parent[parent[x]];\n            x = parent[x];\n        }\n        return x;\n    }\n\n    private static void union(int[] parent, int a, int b) {\n        int ra = find(parent, a), rb = find(parent, b);\n        if (ra != rb) parent[ra] = rb;\n    }\n\n    /** 最优计划中是否包含笛卡尔积节点（连接图断开的直接标志）。 */\n    public static boolean containsCartesian(PlanNode node) {\n        if (node.isLeaf()) return false;\n        return node.kind.equals(PlanNode.CARTESIAN)\n                || containsCartesian(node.left) || containsCartesian(node.right);\n    }\n}\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":82,"oldLines":6,"newStart":82,"newLines":10,"lines":[" ","     private PlanNode buildBest(int mask) {","         int lowest = mask & -mask;  }\n        return result;","originalFile":"package joinopt;\n\nimport java.util.ArrayList;\nimport java.util.LinkedHashMap;\nimport java.util.List;\nimport java.util.Map;\n\n/**\n * 合法连接顺序穷举器（仅用于小规模校验，n ≤ 6）。\n *\n * 递归枚举一个子集 S 的所有<b>二叉连接树</b>：\n * <pre>\n *   |S| = 1 -> 只有扫描叶子\n *   |S| > 1 -> 枚举所有非空真子集 L ⊂ S（L 含 S 最低位），\n *              递归得到 L、R 的全部树，两两组合成一个上层连接节点；\n *              跨 L/R 有等值谓词 -> hashjoin，否则 -> cartesian\n * </pre>\n * 树的总数为 (2n-2)! / (n-1)!（n=6 时 30,240 棵），可在毫秒级穷举完成。\n *\n * 因为 {@link Estimator} 的基数估计与顺序无关，同一掩码的所有候选树根节点\n * estRows 完全相同，差异只来自“哪个中间结果被物化为上层输入”——即代价模型\n * 对树形状的选择。穷举得到的最小代价应与 {@link Optimizer} 的 DP 结果一致。\n */\npublic final class Enumerator {\n\n    public static final int ENUM_LIMIT = 6;\n\n    private final List<Table> tables;\n    private final Estimator estimator;\n    private final java.util.Map<Integer, List<PlanNode>> memo = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n\n    public Enumerator(List<Table> tables, List<JoinPred> preds) {\n        this.tables = tables;\n        this.estimator = new Estimator(tables, preds);\n    }\n\n    /** 一个子集的全部合法计划。 */\n    public List<PlanNode> enumerate(int mask) {\n        List<PlanNode> cached = memo.get(mask);\n        if (cached != null) return cached;\n        List<PlanNode> result = enumerateUncached(mask);\n        memo.put(mask, result);\n        return result;\n    }\n\n    private List<PlanNode> enumerateUncached(int mask) {\n        int n = Integer.bitCount(mask);\n        if (n == 1) {\n            int t = Integer.numberOfTrailingZeros(mask);\n            List<PlanNode> one = new ArrayList<>();\n            PlanNode leaf = PlanNode.leaf(t, tables.get(t).rowCount);\n            leaf.estRows = tables.get(t).rowCount;\n            leaf.cost = 0;\n            one.add(leaf);\n            return one;\n        }\n\n        List<PlanNode> result = new ArrayList<>();\n        int lowest = mask & -mask;\n        int rest = mask ^ lowest;\n        for (int lSub = rest; lSub != 0; lSub = (lSub - 1) & rest) {\n            int leftMask = lowest | lSub;\n            int rightMask = mask ^ leftMask;\n            if (rightMask == 0) continue;\n\n            // 子节点朝向与 DP 保持同一约定：较小表编号在左\n            boolean swap = Integer.numberOfTrailingZeros(leftMask)\n                    > Integer.numberOfTrailingZeros(rightMask);\n            int lm = swap ? rightMask : leftMask;\n            int rm = swap ? leftMask : rightMask;\n\n            List<JoinPred> crossing = estimator.crossingPreds(lm, rm);\n            boolean cartesian = crossing.isEmpty();\n            Stats ls = estimator.estimate(lm);\n            Stats rs = estimator.estimate(rm);\n            double outRows = estimator.joinRows(ls, rs, lm, rm, crossing);\n\n            for (PlanNode l : enumerate(lm)) {\n                for (PlanNode r : enumerate(rm)) {\n                    double nodeCost = PlanNode.nodeCost(\n                            cartesian ? PlanNode.CARTESIAN : PlanNode.HASH_JOIN,\n                            l.estRows, r.estRows, outRows);\n                    PlanNode p = PlanNode.join(cartesian, mask, crossing, l, r,\n                            outRows, l.cost + r.cost + nodeCost);\n                    result.add(p);\n                }\n            }\n        }\n        return result;\n    }\n\n    /** 穷举结果汇总。 */\n    public static final class Report {\n        public final int totalTrees;\n        public final double minCost;\n        public final double maxCost;\n        public final int optimalCount;\n        public final PlanNode anOptimalPlan;\n\n        Report(int totalTrees, double minCost, double maxCost,\n               int optimalCount, PlanNode anOptimalPlan) {\n            this.totalTrees = totalTrees;\n            this.minCost = minCost;\n            this.maxCost = maxCost;\n            this.optimalCount = optimalCount;\n            this.anOptimalPlan = anOptimalPlan;\n        }\n\n        public Map<String, Object> toJson() {\n            Map<String, Object> m = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n            m.put(\"totalTrees\", totalTrees);\n            m.put(\"minCost\", clean(minCost));\n            m.put(\"maxCost\", clean(maxCost));\n            m.put(\"optimalCount\", optimalCount);\n            m.put(\"anOptimalPlan\", anOptimalPlan == null ? null : \"见外层 plan\");\n            return m;\n        }\n\n        private static Object clean(double d) {\n            if (d == Math.rint(d) && !Double.isInfinite(d)) return (long) d;\n            return d;\n        }\n    }\n\n    /** 穷举全部表并汇总最小代价等信息。 */\n    public Report fullReport() {\n        if (tables.size() > ENUM_LIMIT) {\n            throw new IllegalArgumentException(\"穷举仅支持 ≤ \" + ENUM_LIMIT + \" 张表\");\n        }\n        int full = (1 << tables.size()) - 1;\n        List<PlanNode> all = enumerate(full);\n        double min = Double.POSITIVE_INFINITY;\n        double max = Double.NEGATIVE_INFINITY;\n        PlanNode bestOne = null;\n        for (PlanNode p : all) {\n            if (p.cost < min) { min = p.cost; bestOne = p; }\n            if (p.cost > max) max = p.cost;\n        }\n        int ties = 0;\n        for (PlanNode p : all) {\n            if (p.cost == min) ties++;\n        }\n        return new Report(all.size(), min, max, ties, bestOne);\n    }\n\n    /** 二叉连接树总数的理论值 (2n-2)!/(n-1)!，用于和穷举计数对照。 */\n    public static long expectedTreeCount(int n) {\n        long v = 1;\n        for (int k = n; k <= 2 * n - 2; k++) v *= k;\n        return v;\n    }\n}\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":58,"oldLines":33,"newStart":58,"newLines":35,"lines":["         List<PlanNode> result = new ArrayList<>();","         int lowest = mask & -mask;","         int rest = mask ^ lowest;","-        for (int lSub = rest; lSub != 0; lSub = (lSub - 1) & rest) {","+        for (int lSub = rest; ; lSub = (lSub - 1) & rest) {","             int leftMask = lowest | lSub;","             int rightMask = mask ^ leftMask;","-            if (rightMask == 0) continue;"," ","-            // 子节点朝向与 DP 保持同一约定：较小表编号在左","-            boolean swap = Integer.numberOfTrailingZeros(leftMask)","-                    > Integer.numberOfTrailingZeros(rightMask);","-            int lm = swap ? 1) & rest) {\n            int leftMask = lowest | lSub;\n            int rightMask = mask ^ leftMask;\n            if (rightMask != 0) {","originalFile":"package joinopt;\n\nimport java.util.ArrayList;\nimport java.util.Arrays;\nimport java.util.List;\n\n/**\n * 连接顺序动态规划优化器（System R 风格自底向上子集 DP）。\n *\n * <h2>状态定义</h2>\n * 表集合用位掩码表示（最多 8 张表，2^8=256 个子集）。\n * best[mask] = 覆盖该子集的、累计估计代价最小的 {@link PlanNode}。\n *\n * <h2>转移</h2>\n * 对每个子集 S，枚举其所有真子分区 (L, R)（令 L 包含 S 的最低位，\n * 以避免同一分区的重复枚举）：\n * <pre>\n *   crossing = 跨越 L、R 的等值谓词\n *   无 crossing -> 笛卡尔积（NESTEDLOOP）\n *   有 crossing -> 等值哈希连接（一次应用全部跨分区谓词）\n *   cost(S) = cost(L) + cost(R) + nodeCost(本节点)\n * </pre>\n * 取所有分区中代价最小者；代价相同按计划规范串字典序打破平局，保证结果确定。\n *\n * <h2>断开的连接图</h2>\n * 当等值谓词构成的图存在多个连通分量时，分量之间没有任何等值谓词，\n * 任何完整计划都必然包含笛卡尔积节点。DP 不会报错——它会枚举这些分区\n * 并把对应节点标记为 cartesian=true；由于笛卡尔积代价为 |L|×|R|，\n * 优化器会自动把分量之间的笛卡尔积推迟到最后（最小中间结果原则）。\n *\n * <h2>语义不变性</h2>\n * 估计只影响代价与顺序选择；所有计划（含笛卡尔积计划）表达的关系代数语义相同，\n * 执行器对任意合法顺序产生完全一致的结果行集合（见 Executor 与穷举测试）。\n */\npublic final class Optimizer {\n\n    public static final int MAX_TABLES = 8;\n\n    private final List<Table> tables;\n    private final List<JoinPred> preds;\n    private final Estimator estimator;\n\n    private final int full;\n    private final PlanNode[] best;\n    private final double[] bestCost;\n\n    public Optimizer(List<Table> tables, List<JoinPred> preds) {\n        if (tables.isEmpty()) throw new IllegalArgumentException(\"至少需要 1 张表\");\n        if (tables.size() > MAX_TABLES) {\n            throw new IllegalArgumentException(\"最多支持 \" + MAX_TABLES + \" 张表，当前 \"\n                    + tables.size() + \" 张\");\n        }\n        this.tables = tables;\n        this.preds = preds;\n        this.estimator = new Estimator(tables, preds);\n        this.full = (1 << tables.size()) - 1;\n        this.best = new PlanNode[full + 1];\n        this.bestCost = new double[full + 1];\n        solve();\n    }\n\n    private void solve() {\n        int n = tables.size();\n        // 单表\n        for (int t = 0; t < n; t++) {\n            int mask = 1 << t;\n            PlanNode leaf = PlanNode.leaf(t, tables.get(t).rowCount);\n            leaf.estRows = tables.get(t).rowCount;\n            leaf.cost = 0;\n            best[mask] = leaf;\n            bestCost[mask] = 0;\n        }\n        // 多表子集：按子集大小递增\n        for (int size = 2; size <= n; size++) {\n            for (int mask = 1; mask <= full; mask++) {\n                if (Integer.bitCount(mask) != size) continue;\n                best[mask] = buildBest(mask);\n                bestCost[mask] = best[mask].cost;\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    private PlanNode buildBest(int mask) {\n        int lowest = mask & -mask;                 // 最低位\n        PlanNode winner = null;\n        double winnerCost = Double.POSITIVE_INFINITY;\n        String winnerCanonical = null;\n\n        int rest = mask ^ lowest;\n        for (int lSub = rest; ; lSub = (lSub - 1) & rest) {\n            int leftMask = lowest | lSub;\n            int rightMask = mask ^ leftMask;\n\n            PlanNode l = best[leftMask];\n            PlanNode r = best[rightMask];\n            List<JoinPred> crossing = estimator.crossingPreds(leftMask, rightMask);\n            boolean cartesian = crossing.isEmpty();\n\n            // 子节点朝向确定化：包含更小表编号的放左侧（不影响对称代价）\n            if (minTable(leftMask) > minTable(rightMask)) {\n                PlanNode tp = l; int tm = leftMask;\n                l = r; r = tp;\n                leftMask = rightMask; rightMask = tm;\n            }\n\n            double outRows = estimator.joinRows(\n                    estimator.estimate(leftMask), estimator.estimate(rightMask),\n                    leftMask, rightMask, crossing);\n            double nodeCost = PlanNode.nodeCost(\n                    cartesian ? PlanNode.CARTESIAN : PlanNode.HASH_JOIN,\n                    l.estRows, r.estRows, outRows);\n            double total = l.cost + r.cost + nodeCost;\n\n            PlanNode candidate = PlanNode.join(cartesian, mask, crossing, l, r, outRows, total);\n            if (total < winnerCost\n                    || (total == winnerCost\n                        && winnerCanonical != null\n                        && candidate.canonical(tables).compareTo(winnerCanonical) < 0)) {\n                winner = candidate;\n                winnerCost = total;\n                winnerCanonical = candidate.canonical(tables);\n            }\n            if (lSub == 0) break;\n        }\n        if (winner == null) throw new IllegalStateException(\"DP 未为子集 \" + mask + \" 生成计划\");\n        return winner;\n    }\n\n    private static int minTable(int mask) {\n        return Integer.numberOfTrailingZeros(mask);\n    }\n\n    public PlanNode bestPlan() {\n        return best[full];\n    }\n\n    public Estimator estimator() {\n        return estimator;\n    }\n\n    public List<JoinPred> predicates() {\n        return preds;\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * 等值连接图的连通分量（并查集），按分量中的最小表编号排序。\n     * 结果多于 1 个即说明连接图断开，完整计划必然含笛卡尔积。\n     */\n    public List<Integer> connectedComponents() {\n        int n = tables.size();\n        int[] parent = new int[n];\n        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) parent[i] = i;\n        for (JoinPred p : preds) union(parent, p.leftTable, p.rightTable);\n\n        // 根 -> 分量掩码；为保持顺序确定，按表编号递增遇到新分量再建桶\n        int[] maskOfRoot = new int[n];\n        Arrays.fill(maskOfRoot, -1);\n        List<Integer> masks = new ArrayList<>();\n        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {\n            int root = find(parent, i);\n            if (maskOfRoot[root] < 0) {\n                maskOfRoot[root] = masks.size();\n                masks.add(0);\n            }\n            masks.set(maskOfRoot[root], masks.get(maskOfRoot[root]) | (1 << i));\n        }\n        masks.sort((a, b) -> Integer.compare(minTable(a), minTable(b)));\n        return masks;\n    }\n\n    private static int find(int[] parent, int x) {\n        while (parent[x] != x) {\n            parent[x] = parent[parent[x]];\n            x = parent[x];\n        }\n        return x;\n    }\n\n    private static void union(int[] parent, int a, int b) {\n        int ra = find(parent, a), rb = find(parent, b);\n        if (ra != rb) parent[ra] = rb;\n    }\n\n    /** 最优计划中是否包含笛卡尔积节点（连接图断开的直接标志）。 */\n    public static boolean containsCartesian(PlanNode node) {\n        if (node.isLeaf()) return false;\n        return node.kind.equals(PlanNode.CARTESIAN)\n                || containsCartesian(node.left) || containsCartesian(node.right);\n    }\n}\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":90,"oldLines":8,"newStart":90,"newLines":7,"lines":["         for (int lSub = rest;      winnerCanonical = candidate.canonical(tables);\n                }\n            }\n            if (lSub == 0) break;\n        }","originalFile":"package joinopt;\n\nimport java.util.ArrayList;\nimport java.util.Arrays;\nimport java.util.List;\n\n/**\n * 连接顺序动态规划优化器（System R 风格自底向上子集 DP）。\n *\n * <h2>状态定义</h2>\n * 表集合用位掩码表示（最多 8 张表，2^8=256 个子集）。\n * best[mask] = 覆盖该子集的、累计估计代价最小的 {@link PlanNode}。\n *\n * <h2>转移</h2>\n * 对每个子集 S，枚举其所有真子分区 (L, R)（令 L 包含 S 的最低位，\n * 以避免同一分区的重复枚举）：\n * <pre>\n *   crossing = 跨越 L、R 的等值谓词\n *   无 crossing -> 笛卡尔积（NESTEDLOOP）\n *   有 crossing -> 等值哈希连接（一次应用全部跨分区谓词）\n *   cost(S) = cost(L) + cost(R) + nodeCost(本节点)\n * </pre>\n * 取所有分区中代价最小者；代价相同按计划规范串字典序打破平局，保证结果确定。\n *\n * <h2>断开的连接图</h2>\n * 当等值谓词构成的图存在多个连通分量时，分量之间没有任何等值谓词，\n * 任何完整计划都必然包含笛卡尔积节点。DP 不会报错——它会枚举这些分区\n * 并把对应节点标记为 cartesian=true；由于笛卡尔积代价为 |L|×|R|，\n * 优化器会自动把分量之间的笛卡尔积推迟到最后（最小中间结果原则）。\n *\n * <h2>语义不变性</h2>\n * 估计只影响代价与顺序选择；所有计划（含笛卡尔积计划）表达的关系代数语义相同，\n * 执行器对任意合法顺序产生完全一致的结果行集合（见 Executor 与穷举测试）。\n */\npublic final class Optimizer {\n\n    public static final int MAX_TABLES = 8;\n\n    private final List<Table> tables;\n    private final List<JoinPred> preds;\n    private final Estimator estimator;\n\n    private final int full;\n    private final PlanNode[] best;\n    private final double[] bestCost;\n\n    public Optimizer(List<Table> tables, List<JoinPred> preds) {\n        if (tables.isEmpty()) throw new IllegalArgumentException(\"至少需要 1 张表\");\n        if (tables.size() > MAX_TABLES) {\n            throw new IllegalArgumentException(\"最多支持 \" + MAX_TABLES + \" 张表，当前 \"\n                    + tables.size() + \" 张\");\n        }\n        this.tables = tables;\n        this.preds = preds;\n        this.estimator = new Estimator(tables, preds);\n        this.full = (1 << tables.size()) - 1;\n        this.best = new PlanNode[full + 1];\n        this.bestCost = new double[full + 1];\n        solve();\n    }\n\n    private void solve() {\n        int n = tables.size();\n        // 单表\n        for (int t = 0; t < n; t++) {\n            int mask = 1 << t;\n            PlanNode leaf = PlanNode.leaf(t, tables.get(t).rowCount);\n            leaf.estRows = tables.get(t).rowCount;\n            leaf.cost = 0;\n            best[mask] = leaf;\n            bestCost[mask] = 0;\n        }\n        // 多表子集：按子集大小递增\n        for (int size = 2; size <= n; size++) {\n            for (int mask = 1; mask <= full; mask++) {\n                if (Integer.bitCount(mask) != size) continue;\n                best[mask] = buildBest(mask);\n                bestCost[mask] = best[mask].cost;\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    private PlanNode buildBest(int mask) {\n        int lowest = mask & -mask;                 // 最低位\n        PlanNode winner = null;\n        double winnerCost = Double.POSITIVE_INFINITY;\n        String winnerCanonical = null;\n\n        int rest = mask ^ lowest;\n        for (int lSub = rest; ; lSub = (lSub - 1) & rest) {\n            int leftMask = lowest | lSub;\n            int rightMask = mask ^ leftMask;\n            if (rightMask != 0) {\n            PlanNode r = best[rightMask];\n            List<JoinPred> crossing = estimator.crossingPreds(leftMask, rightMask);\n            boolean cartesian = crossing.isEmpty();\n\n            // 子节点朝向确定化：包含更小表编号的放左侧（不影响对称代价）\n            if (minTable(leftMask) > minTable(rightMask)) {\n                PlanNode tp = l; int tm = leftMask;\n                l = r; r = tp;\n                leftMask = rightMask; rightMask = tm;\n            }\n\n            double outRows = estimator.joinRows(\n                    estimator.estimate(leftMask), estimator.estimate(rightMask),\n                    leftMask, rightMask, crossing);\n            double nodeCost = PlanNode.nodeCost(\n                    cartesian ? PlanNode.CARTESIAN : PlanNode.HASH_JOIN,\n                    l.estRows, r.estRows, outRows);\n            double total = l.cost + r.cost + nodeCost;\n\n            PlanNode candidate = PlanNode.join(cartesian, mask, crossing, l, r, outRows, total);\n            if (total < winnerCost\n                    || (total == winnerCost\n                        && winnerCanonical != null\n                        && candidate.canonical(tables).compareTo(winnerCanonical) < 0)) {\n                winner = candidate;\n                winnerCost = total;\n                winnerCanonical = candidate.canonical(tables);\n            }\n            if (lSub == 0) break;\n        }\n        if (winner == null) throw new IllegalStateException(\"DP 未为子集 \" + mask + \" 生成计划\");\n        return winner;\n    }\n\n    private static int minTable(int mask) {\n        return Integer.numberOfTrailingZeros(mask);\n    }\n\n    public PlanNode bestPlan() {\n        return best[full];\n    }\n\n    public Estimator estimator() {\n        return estimator;\n    }\n\n    public List<JoinPred> predicates() {\n        return preds;\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * 等值连接图的连通分量（并查集），按分量中的最小表编号排序。\n     * 结果多于 1 个即说明连接图断开，完整计划必然含笛卡尔积。\n     */\n    public List<Integer> connectedComponents() {\n        int n = tables.size();\n        int[] parent = new int[n];\n        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) parent[i] = i;\n        for (JoinPred p : preds) union(parent, p.leftTable, p.rightTable);\n\n        // 根 -> 分量掩码；为保持顺序确定，按表编号递增遇到新分量再建桶\n        int[] maskOfRoot = new int[n];\n        Arrays.fill(maskOfRoot, -1);\n        List<Integer> masks = new ArrayList<>();\n        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {\n            int root = find(parent, i);\n            if (maskOfRoot[root] < 0) {\n                maskOfRoot[root] = masks.size();\n                masks.add(0);\n            }\n            masks.set(maskOfRoot[root], masks.get(maskOfRoot[root]) | (1 << i));\n        }\n        masks.sort((a, b) -> Integer.compare(minTable(a), minTable(b)));\n        return masks;\n    }\n\n    private static int find(int[] parent, int x) {\n        while (parent[x] != x) {\n            parent[x] = parent[parent[x]];\n            x = parent[x];\n        }\n        return x;\n    }\n\n    private static void union(int[] parent, int a, int b) {\n        int ra = find(parent, a), rb = find(parent, b);\n        if (ra != rb) parent[ra] = rb;\n    }\n\n    /** 最优计划中是否包含笛卡尔积节点（连接图断开的直接标志）。 */\n    public static boolean containsCartesian(PlanNode node) {\n        if (node.isLeaf()) return false;\n        return node.kind.equals(PlanNode.CARTESIAN)\n                || containsCartesian(node.left) || containsCartesian(node.right);\n    }\n}\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":91,"oldLines":33,"newStart":91,"newLines":35,"lines":["             int leftMask = lowest | lSub;","             int rightMask = mask ^ leftMask;","             if (rightMask != 0) {","-            PlanNode r = best[rightMask];","-            List<JoinPred> crossing = estimator.crossingPreds(leftMask, rightMask);","-            boolean cartesian = crossing.isEmpty();","+                PlanNode l = best[leftMask];","+                PlanNode r = best[rightMask];","+                List<JoinPred> crossing = estimator.crossingPreds(leftMask, rightMask);","+                boolean cartesian = crossing.isEmpty();"," ","-            // 子节点朝向确定化：包含更小表编号的放左侧（不影响对称代价）","-            if (minTable(leftMask) > minTable(rightMask)) {","-                PlanNode tp = l; joinopt;\n\nimport java.util.ArrayList;\nimport java.util.Arrays;\nimport java.util.List;\n\n/**\n * 等值连接图的连通分量（并查集），供 DP 与穷举器共享“合法分区”判定。\n *\n * 合法分区规则（对应 System R 动态规划中“只枚举连通子问题”的经典约束）：\n * <ul>\n *   <li>S 是连通子集时，只接受<b>有跨分区等值谓词</b>的分区（不允许凭空造笛卡尔积）；</li>\n *   <li>S 跨越多个连通分量时，任何分区都没有跨边，且两个分区必须各自是\n *       若干完整分量的并（分量绝不能被拆开）。</li>\n * </ul>\n * 这样：连通查询产生纯等值连接计划；断开的连接图只在分量之间出现笛卡尔积节点，\n * 且这些笛卡尔积被代价模型自然推迟到最小中间结果的位置。\n */\npublic final class Components {\n\n    /** 每个连通分量的表掩码。 */\n    public final List<Integer> componentMasks;\n    private final int[] componentOfTable;\n\n    public Components(int tableCount, List<JoinPred> preds) {\n        int[] parent = new int[tableCount];\n        for (int i = 0; i < tableCount; i++) parent[i] = i;\n        for (JoinPred p : preds) union(parent, p.leftTable, p.rightTable);\n\n        int[] rootToComp = new int[tableCount];\n        Arrays.fill(rootToComp, -1);\n        List<Integer> masks = new ArrayList<>();\n        int[] compOf = new int[tableCount];\n        for (int i = 0; i < tableCount; i++) {\n            int root = find(parent, i);\n            if (rootToComp[root] < 0) {\n                rootToComp[root] = masks.size();\n                masks.add(0);\n            }\n            int c = rootToComp[root];\n            compOf[i] = c;\n            masks.set(c, masks.get(c) | (1 << i));\n        }\n        this.componentMasks = masks;\n        this.componentOfTable = compOf;\n    }\n\n    /** mask 是否恰好由若干完整连通分量构成（单分量也算）。 */\n    public boolean isUnionOfComponents(int mask) {\n        int covered = 0;\n        for (int cMask : componentMasks) {\n            if ((mask & cMask) != 0) covered |= cMask;\n        }\n        return covered == mask;\n    }\n\n    /** mask 是否为单个连通分量的子集（落在一个分量内）。 */\n    public boolean liesWithinOneComponent(int mask) {\n        int c = -1;\n        for (int t = 0; t < componentOfTable.length; t++) {\n            if (((mask >>> t) & 1) == 1) {\n                if (c < 0) c = componentOfTable[t];\n                else if (c != componentOfTable[t]) return false;\n            }\n        }\n        return true;\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * 分区 (leftMask, rightMask) 是否合法。\n     * 单连通分量内部 -> 必须有跨边；跨分量 -> 两侧都必须是完整分量的并（此时必无跨边）。\n     */\n    public boolean legalSplit(int leftMask, int rightMask, boolean hasCrossingPred) {\n        if (liesWithinOneComponent(leftMask | rightMask)) {\n            return hasCrossingPred;\n        }\n        return !hasCrossingPred\n                && isUnionOfComponents(leftMask)\n                && isUnionOfComponents(rightMask);\n    }\n\n    public int size() {\n        return componentMasks.size();\n    }\n\n    private static int find(int[] parent, int x) {\n        while (parent[x] != x) {\n            parent[x] = parent[parent[x]];\n            x = parent[x];\n        }\n        return x;\n    }\n\n    private static void union(int[] parent, int a, int b) {\n        int ra = find(parent, a), rb = find(parent, b);\n        if (ra != rb) parent[ra] = rb;\n    }\n}\n"},"name":"Write","type":"tool_use"}],"id":"msg_b37c19f52244313c9c9655e5","model":"auto_model/urm","role":"assistant","stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"type":"message","usage":{"input_tokens":2213,"cache_creation_input_tokens":0,"cache_read_input_tokens":72504,"output_tokens":2471,"output_tokens_details":{"thinking_tokens":0},"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"","iterations":[],"speed":"standard"},"stop_details":null},"wireToolInputs":{"call_5fxyy3f1c3op8dzo7c26iiiu":{"content":"package 1];\n        solve();\n    }\n\n    private void solve() {\n        int n = tables.size();\n        // 单表\n        for (int t = 0; t < n; t++) {\n            int mask = 1 << t;\n            PlanNode PlanNode l = best[leftMask];\n                PlanNode r = best[rightMask];\n                List<JoinPred> crossing = estimator.crossingPreds(leftMask, rightMask);\n                boolean cartesian = crossing.isEmpty();\n\n                // 子节点朝向确定化：包含更小表编号的放左侧（不影响对称代价）\n                if (minTable(leftMask) > minTable(rightMask)) {\n                    PlanNode tp = l; int tm = leftMask;\n
