分区两侧之间存在等值谓词 -> HASH JOIN（一次应用全部跨分区谓词）\n *   不存在谓词，但两侧各为完整分量的并 -> CARTESIAN（嵌套循环）\n *   其余分区非法，跳过\n *   cost(S) = cost(L) + cost(R) + nodeCost(本节点)\n * </pre>\n * 取所有候选中代价最小者；代价相同按计划规范串字典序打破平局，保证结果确定。\n *\n * <h2>断开的连接图</h2>\n * 当等值谓词构成的图存在多个连通分量时，分量之间没有等值谓词，完整计划必然\n * 包含笛卡尔积节点。DP 只在“完整分量之间”引入笛卡尔积，绝不把一个分量拆散\n * 后凭空做积（那类计划不合法）。由于笛卡尔积代价为 |L|×|R|，优化器会把\n * 分量间的积推迟到代价最小的位置。\n *\n * <h2>语义不变性</h2>\n * 估计只影响代价与顺序选择；所有合法计划表达的关系代数语义相同，\n * 执行器对任意合法顺序产生完全一致的结果行多重集合（见 Executor 与穷举测试）。\n */\npublic final class Optimizer {\n\n    public static final int MAX_TABLES = 8;\n\n    private final List<Table> tables;\n    private final List<JoinPred> preds;\n    private final Estimator estimator;\n    private final Components components;\n\n    private final int full;\n    private final PlanNode[] best;\n    private final double[] bestCost;\n\n    public Optimizer(List<Table> tables, List<JoinPred> preds) {\n        if (tables.isEmpty()) throw new IllegalArgumentException(\"至少需要 1 张表\");\n        if (tables.size() > MAX_TABLES) {\n            throw new IllegalArgumentException(\"最多支持 \" + MAX_TABLES + \" 张表，当前 \"\n                    + tables.size() + \" 张\");\n        }\n        this.tables = tables;\n        this.preds = preds;\n        this.estimator = new Estimator(tables, preds);\n        this.components = new Components(tables.size(), preds);\n        this.full = (1 << tables.size()) - 1;\n        this.best = new PlanNode[full + 1];\n        this.bestCost = new double[full + 1];\n        solve();\n    }\n\n    private void solve() {\n        int n = tables.size();\n        for (int t = 0; t < n; t++) {\n            int mask = 1 << t;\n            PlanNode leaf = PlanNode.leaf(t, tables.get(t).rowCount);\n            leaf.estRows = tables.get(t).rowCount;\n            leaf.cost = 0;\n            best[mask] = leaf;\n            bestCost[mask] = 0;\n        }\n        for (int size = 2; size <= n; size++) {\n            for (int mask = 1; mask <= full; mask++) {\n                if (Integer.bitCount(mask) != size) continue;\n                PlanNode plan = buildBest(mask);\n                if (plan != null) {\n                    best[mask] = plan;\n                    bestCost[mask] = plan.cost;\n                }\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    /** 不可达子集返回 null。 */\n    private PlanNode buildBest(int mask) {\n        PlanNode winner = null;\n        double winnerCost = Double.POSITIVE_INFINITY;\n        String winnerCanonical = null;\n\n        int lowest = mask & -mask;\n        int rest = mask ^ lowest;\n        for (int lSub = rest; ; lSub = (lSub - 1) & rest) {\n            int aMask = lowest | lSub;\n            int bMask = mask ^ aMask;\n            if (bMask != 0 && best[aMask] != null && best[bMask] != null) {\n                List<JoinPred> crossing = estimator.crossingPreds(aMask, bMask);\n                boolean legal = components.legalSplit(aMask, bMask, !crossing.isEmpty());\n                if (legal) {\n                    // 两种子节点朝向各产生一棵候选树\n                    PlanNode[] cands = {\n                            candidateFor(mask, best[aMask], best[bMask], aMask, bMask, crossing),\n                            candidateFor(mask, best[bMask], best[aMask], bMask, aMask, crossing)\n                    };\n                    for (PlanNode candidate : cands) {\n                        if (candidate.cost < winnerCost\n                                || (candidate.cost == winnerCost\n                                    && winnerCanonical != null\n                                    && candidate.canonical(tables).compareTo(winnerCanonical) < 0)) {\n                            winner = candidate;\n                            winnerCost = candidate.cost;\n                            winnerCanonical = candidate.canonical(tables);\n                        }\n                    }\n                }\n            }\n            if (lSub == 0) break;\n        }\n        return winner;\n    }\n\n    private PlanNode candidateFor(int mask, PlanNode leftPlan, PlanNode rightPlan,\n                                  int leftMask, int rightMask, List<JoinPred> crossing) {\n        boolean cartesian = crossing.isEmpty();\n        double outRows = estimator.joinRows(\n                estimator.estimate(leftMask), estimator.estimate(rightMask),\n                leftMask, rightMask, crossing);\n        double nodeCost = PlanNode.nodeCost(\n                cartesian ? PlanNode.CARTESIAN : PlanNode.HASH_JOIN,\n                leftPlan.estRows, rightPlan.estRows, outRows);\n        double total = leftPlan.cost + rightPlan.cost + nodeCost;\n        return PlanNode.join(cartesian, mask, crossing, leftPlan, rightPlan, outRows, total);\n    }\n\n    private static int minTable(int mask) {\n        return Integer.numberOfTrailingZeros(mask);\n    }\n\n    public PlanNode bestPlan() {\n        PlanNode p = best[full];\n        if (p == null) {\n            throw new IllegalStateException(\"无法为全部表构造连接计划（不应发生：分量之并总可做笛卡尔积）\");\n        }\n        return p;\n    }\n\n    public Estimator estimator() {\n        return estimator;\n    }\n\n    public Components components() {\n        return components;\n    }\n\n    public List<JoinPred> predicates() {\n        return preds;\n    }\n\n    /** 连通分量掩码列表（多于 1 个即连接图断开，完整计划必含笛卡尔积）。 */\n    public List<Integer> connectedComponents() {\n        return components.componentMasks;\n    }\n\n    /** 最优计划中是否包含笛卡尔积节点（连接图断开的直接标志）。 */\n    public static boolean containsCartesian(PlanNode node) {\n        if (node.isLeaf()) return false;\n        return node.kind.equals(PlanNode.CARTESIAN)\n                || containsCartesian(node.left) || containsCartesian(node.right);\n    }\n}\n"},"name":"Write","type":"tool_use"}],"id":"msg_b64902ca95d9642c488a0560","model":"auto_model/urm","role":"assistant","stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"type":"message","usage":{"input_tokens":3376,"cache_creation_input_tokens":0,"cache_read_input_tokens":75576,"output_tokens":1999,"output_tokens_details":{"thinking_tokens":0},"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"","iterations":[],"speed":"standard"},"stop_details":null},"wireToolInputs":{"call_w0teomffdhgtyu0oatntc9u1":{"content":"package (node.isLeaf()) return false;"]}],"originalFile":"package joinopt;\n\nimport java.util.ArrayList;\nimport java.util.Arrays;\nimport java.util.List;\n\n/**\n * 连接顺序动态规划优化器（System R 风格自底向上子集 DP）。\n *\n * <h2>状态定义</h2>\n * 表集合用位掩码表示（最多 8 张表，2^8=256 个子集）。\n * best[mask] = 覆盖该子集的、累计估计代价最小的 {@link PlanNode}。\n *\n * <h2>转移</h2>\n * 对每个子集 S，枚举其所有真子分区 (L, R)（令 L 包含 S 的最低位，\n * 以避免同一分区的重复枚举）：\n * <pre>\n *   crossing = 跨越 L、R 的等值谓词\n *   无 crossing -> 笛卡尔积（NESTEDLOOP）\n *   有 crossing -> 等值哈希连接（一次应用全部跨分区谓词）\n *   cost(S) = cost(L) + cost(R) + nodeCost(本节点)\n * </pre>\n * 取所有分区中代价最小者；代价相同按计划规范串字典序打破平局，保证结果确定。\n *\n * <h2>断开的连接图</h2>\n * 当等值谓词构成的图存在多个连通分量时，分量之间没有任何等值谓词，\n * 任何完整计划都必然包含笛卡尔积节点。DP 不会报错——它会枚举这些分区\n * 并把对应节点标记为 cartesian=true；由于笛卡尔积代价为 |L|×|R|，\n * 优化器会自动把分量之间的笛卡尔积推迟到最后（最小中间结果原则）。\n *\n * <h2>语义不变性</h2>\n * 估计只影响代价与顺序选择；所有计划（含笛卡尔积计划）表达的关系代数语义相同，\n * 执行器对任意合法顺序产生完全一致的结果行集合（见 Executor 与穷举测试）。\n */\npublic final class Optimizer {\n\n    public static final int MAX_TABLES = 8;\n\n    private final List<Table> tables;\n    private final List<JoinPred> preds;\n    private final Estimator estimator;\n\n    private final int full;\n    private final PlanNode[] best;\n    private final double[] bestCost;\n\n    public Optimizer(List<Table> tables, List<JoinPred> preds) {\n        if (tables.isEmpty()) throw new IllegalArgumentException(\"至少需要 1 张表\");\n        if (tables.size() > MAX_TABLES) {\n            throw new IllegalArgumentException(\"最多支持 \" + MAX_TABLES + \" 张表，当前 \"\n                    + tables.size() + \" 张\");\n        }\n        this.tables = tables;\n        this.preds = preds;\n        this.estimator = new Estimator(tables, preds);\n        this.full = (1 << tables.size()) - 1;\n        this.best = new PlanNode[full + 1];\n        this.bestCost = new double[full + 1];\n        solve();\n    }\n\n    private void solve() {\n        int n = tables.size();\n        // 单表\n        for (int t = 0; t < n; t++) {\n            int mask = 1 << t;\n            PlanNode leaf = PlanNode.leaf(t, tables.get(t).rowCount);\n            leaf.estRows = tables.get(t).rowCount;\n            leaf.cost = 0;\n            best[mask] = leaf;\n            bestCost[mask] = 0;\n        }\n        // 多表子集：按子集大小递增\n        for (int size = 2; size <= n; size++) {\n            for (int mask = 1; mask <= full; mask++) {\n                if (Integer.bitCount(mask) != size) continue;\n                best[mask] = buildBest(mask);\n                bestCost[mask] = best[mask].cost;\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    private PlanNode buildBest(int mask) {\n        int lowest = mask & -mask;                 // 最低位\n        PlanNode winner = null;\n        double winnerCost = Double.POSITIVE_INFINITY;\n        String winnerCanonical = null;\n\n        int rest = mask ^ lowest;\n        for (int lSub = rest; ; lSub = (lSub - 1) & rest) {\n            int leftMask = lowest | lSub;\n            int rightMask = mask ^ leftMask;\n            if (rightMask != 0) {\n                PlanNode l = best[leftMask];\n                PlanNode r = best[rightMask];\n                List<JoinPred> crossing = estimator.crossingPreds(leftMask, rightMask);\n                boolean cartesian = crossing.isEmpty();\n\n                // 子节点朝向确定化：包含更小表编号的放左侧（不影响对称代价）\n                if (minTable(leftMask) > minTable(rightMask)) {\n                    PlanNode tp = l; int tm = leftMask;\n                    l = r; r = tp;\n                    leftMask = rightMask; rightMask = tm;\n                }\n\n                double outRows = estimator.joinRows(\n                        estimator.estimate(leftMask), estimator.estimate(rightMask),\n                        leftMask, rightMask, crossing);\n                double nodeCost = PlanNode.nodeCost(\n                        cartesian ? PlanNode.CARTESIAN : PlanNode.HASH_JOIN,\n                        l.estRows, r.estRows, outRows);\n                double total = l.cost + r.cost + nodeCost;\n\n                PlanNode candidate = PlanNode.join(cartesian, mask, crossing, l, r, outRows, total);\n                if (total < winnerCost\n                        || (total == winnerCost\n                            && winnerCanonical != null\n                            && candidate.canonical(tables).compareTo(winnerCanonical) < 0)) {\n                    winner = candidate;\n                    winnerCost = total;\n                    winnerCanonical = candidate.canonical(tables);\n                }\n            }\n            if (lSub == 0) break;\n        }\n        if (winner == null) throw new IllegalStateException(\"DP 未为子集 \" + mask + \" 生成计划\");\n        return winner;\n    }\n\n    private static int minTable(int mask) {\n        return Integer.numberOfTrailingZeros(mask);\n    }\n\n    public PlanNode bestPlan() {\n        return best[full];\n    }\n\n    public Estimator estimator() {\n        return estimator;\n    }\n\n    public List<JoinPred> predicates() {\n        return preds;\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * 等值连接图的连通分量（并查集），按分量中的最小表编号排序。\n     * 结果多于 1 个即说明连接图断开，完整计划必然含笛卡尔积。\n     */\n    public List<Integer> connectedComponents() {\n        int n = tables.size();\n        int[] parent = new int[n];\n        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) parent[i] = i;\n        for (JoinPred p : preds) union(parent, p.leftTable, p.rightTable);\n\n        // 根 -> 分量掩码；为保持顺序确定，按表编号递增遇到新分量再建桶\n        int[] maskOfRoot = new int[n];\n        Arrays.fill(maskOfRoot, -1);\n        List<Integer> masks = new ArrayList<>();\n        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {\n            int root = find(parent, i);\n            if (maskOfRoot[root] < 0) {\n                maskOfRoot[root] = masks.size();\n                masks.add(0);\n            }\n            masks.set(maskOfRoot[root], masks.get(maskOfRoot[root]) | (1 << i));\n        }\n        masks.sort((a, b) -> Integer.compare(minTable(a), minTable(b)));\n        return masks;\n    }\n\n    private static int find(int[] parent, int x) {\n        while (parent[x] != x) {\n            parent[x] = parent[parent[x]];\n            x = parent[x];\n        }\n        return x;\n    }\n\n    private static void union(int[] parent, int a, int b) {\n        int ra = find(parent, a), rb = find(parent, b);\n        if (ra != rb) parent[ra] = rb;\n    }\n\n    /** 最优计划中是否包含笛卡尔积节点（连接图断开的直接标志）。 */\n    public static boolean containsCartesian(PlanNode node) {\n        if (node.isLeaf()) return false;\n        return node.kind.equals(PlanNode.CARTESIAN)\n                || containsCartesian(node.left) || containsCartesian(node.right);\n    }\n}\n","userModified":false},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"82724b3c-5955-447c-98f1-765ece3d3dc3","session_id":"90b11851-b85c-4121-bed4-1de860a4594d","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp17/b","sessionId":"90b11851-b85c-4121-bed4-1de860a4594d","version":"2.1.280","gitBranch":"ab/run-20260922T151547Z/opp17-b","slug":"streamed-doodling-badger"}

joinopt;\n\nimport java.util.ArrayList;\nimport java.util.LinkedHashMap;\nimport java.util.List;\nimport java.util.Map;\n\n/**\n * 合法连接顺序穷举器（仅用于小规模校验，n ≤ 6）。\n *\n * 递归枚举一个可达子集 S 的所有<b>二叉连接树</b>（左右子节点有序）：\n * <pre>\n *   |S| = 1 -> 只有扫描叶子\n *   |S| > 1 -> 枚举所有无向真分区（一侧含 S 最低位）；\n *              对每个合法分区，递归 L、R 全部树，\n *              并分别以 (L,R) 与 (R,L) 两种朝向组合上层节点\n * </pre>\n * 合法性判定与 DP 完全一致（见 {@link Components}）：\n * 连通子集的分区必须有跨边（哈希连接）；跨分量分区两侧必须是完整分量之并\n * （笛卡尔积）。不可达子集没有任何计划。\n *\n * 无任何谓词时，n 个表的合法树总数为 (2n-2)!/(n-1)!：\n * n=1..6 依次为 1, 2, 12, 120, 1680, 30240。穷举结果用于校验\n * {@link Optimizer} 的 DP 找到的最小代价与全局最小值完全一致。\n */\npublic final class Enumerator {\n\n    public static final int ENUM_LIMIT = 6;\n\n    private final List<Table> tables;\n    private final Estimator estimator;\n    private final Components components;\n    private final Map<Integer, List<PlanNode>> memo = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n\n    public Enumerator(List<Table> tables, List<JoinPred> preds) {\n        this.tables = tables;\n        this.estimator = new Estimator(tables, preds);\n        this.components = new Components(tables.size(), preds);\n    }\n\n    /** 一个子集的全部合法计划；不可达子集返回空列表。 */\n    public List<PlanNode> enumerate(int mask) {\n        if (memo.containsKey(mask)) return memo.get(mask);\n        List<PlanNode> result = enumerateUncached(mask);\n        memo.put(mask, result);\n        return result;\n    }\n\n    private List<PlanNode> enumerateUncached(int mask) {\n        if (Integer.bitCount(mask) == 1) {\n            int t = Integer.numberOfTrailingZeros(mask);\n            List<PlanNode> one = new ArrayList<>();\n            PlanNode leaf = PlanNode.leaf(t, tables.get(t).rowCount);\n            leaf.estRows = tables.get(t).rowCount;\n            leaf.cost = 0;\n            one.add(leaf);\n            return one;\n        }\n\n        List<PlanNode> result = new ArrayList<>();\n        int lowest = mask & -mask;\n        int rest = mask ^ lowest;\n        for (int lSub = rest; ; lSub = (lSub - 1) & rest) {\n            int aMask = lowest | lSub;\n            int bMask = mask ^ aMask;\n            if (bMask != 0) {\n                List<PlanPred> aPlans = wrap(enumerate(aMask));\n                List<PlanPred> bPlans = wrap(enumerate(bMask));\n                if (!aPlans.isEmpty() && !bPlans.isEmpty()) {\n                    List<JoinPred> crossing = estimator.crossingPreds(aMask, bMask);\n                    if (components.legalSplit(aMask, bMask, !crossing.isEmpty())) {\n                        // 两种朝向：(A 在左,B 在右) 与 (B 在左,A 在右)\n                        addCombos(result, mask, aPlans, bPlans, aMask, bMask, crossing);\n                        addCombos(result, mask, bPlans, aPlans, bMask, aMask, crossing);\n                    }\n                }\n            }\n            if (lSub == 0) break;\n        }\n        return result;\n    }\n\n    /** 携带自身掩码的计划包装，便于组合时取对侧列。 */\n    private static final class PlanPred {\n        final PlanNode node;\n        PlanPred(PlanNode node) { this.node = node; }\n    }\n\n    private List<PlanPred> wrap(List<PlanNode> nodes) {\n        List<PlanPred> out = new ArrayList<>(nodes.size());\n        for (PlanNode n : nodes) out.add(new PlanPred(n));\n        return out;\n    }\n\n    private void addCombos(List<PlanNode> out, int mask,\n                           List<PlanPred> lefts, List<PlanPred> rights,\n                           int leftMask, int rightMask, List<JoinPred> crossing) {\n        boolean cartesian = crossing.isEmpty();\n        Stats ls = estimator.estimate(leftMask);\n        Stats rs = estimator.estimate(rightMask);\n        double outRows = estimator.joinRows(ls, rs, leftMask, rightMask, crossing);\n        for (PlanPred l : lefts) {\n            for (PlanPred r : rights) {\n                double nodeCost = PlanNode.nodeCost(\n                        cartesian ? PlanNode.CARTESIAN : PlanNode.HASH_JOIN,\n                        l.node.estRows, r.node.estRows, outRows);\n                out.add(PlanNode.join(cartesian, mask, crossing,\n                        l.node, r.node, outRows, l.node.cost + r.node.cost + nodeCost));\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    /** 穷举结果汇总。 */\n    public static final class Report {\n        public final int totalTrees;\n        public final double minCost;\n        public final double maxCost;\n        public final int optimalCount;\n        public final PlanNode anOptimalPlan;\n        public final long expectedTreeCount;\n\n        Report(int totalTrees, double minCost, double maxCost, int optimalCount,\n               PlanNode anOptimalPlan, long expectedTreeCount) {\n            this.totalTrees = totalTrees;\n            this.minCost = minCost;\n            this.maxCost = maxCost;\n            this.optimalCount = optimalCount;\n            this.anOptimalPlan = anOptimalPlan;\n            this.expectedTreeCount = expectedTreeCount;\n        }\n\n        public Map<String, Object> toJson() {\n            Map<String, Object> m = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n            m.put(\"totalTrees\", totalTrees);\n            m.put(\"expectedTreeCount\", expectedTreeCount);\n            m.put(\"minCost\", clean(minCost));\n            m.put(\"maxCost\", clean(maxCost));\n            m.put(\"optimalCount\", optimalCount);\n            return m;\n        }\n\n        private static Object clean(double d) {\n            if (d == Math.rint(d) && !Double.isInfinite(d)) return (long) d;\n            return d;\n        }\n    }\n\n    /** 穷举全部表并汇总最小代价等信息。 */\n    public Report fullReport() {\n        if (tables.size() > ENUM_LIMIT) {\n            throw new IllegalArgumentException(\"穷举仅支持 ≤ \" + ENUM_LIMIT + \" 张表\");\n        }\n        int full = (1 << tables.size()) - 1;\n        List<PlanNode> all = enumerate(full);\n        if (all.isEmpty()) {\n            throw new IllegalStateException(\"穷举未得到任何完整计划（不应发生）\");\n        }\n        double min = Double.POSITIVE_INFINITY;\n        double max = Double.NEGATIVE_INFINITY;\n        PlanNode bestOne = null;\n        for (PlanNode p : all) {\n            if (p.cost < min) { min = p.cost; bestOne = p; }\n            if (p.cost > max) max = p.cost;\n        }\n        int ties = 0;\n        for (PlanNode p : all) if (p.cost == min) ties++;\n        long expected = expectedTreeCount(tables.size(), components.size());\n        return new Report(all.size(), min, max, ties, bestOne, expected);\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * 合法完整树的理论数量：\n     * 若有 c 个连通分量，大小为 s1..sc，则\n     *   总数 = Π f(si)  ×  两色有序二叉组合因子\n     * 其中 f(s)=(2s-2)!/(s-1)! 是单个分量（连通）的有序二叉树数，\n     * 再乘 c 个“分量根”拼装成一棵有序树的方式数（见 README 说明）。\n     * 对 c=1 即 f(n)；对无任何边（c=n, 每个分量大小 1）同样等于 f(n)。\n     */\n    public static long expectedTreeCount(int n, int componentCount) {\n        // 通用实现：直接用“无约束有序二叉树数”f(n) 作为上界公式。\n        // 当所有分量大小均为 1 或只有一个分量时它就是精确值；\n        // 对混合断开情况，穷举计数本身为准，此值仅在简单场景断言。\n        long v = 1;\n        for (int k = n; k <= 2 * n - 2; k++) v *= k;\n        return v;\n    }\n}\n"},"name":"Write","type":"tool_use"}],"id":"msg_e4816e3288f93b1f2ec1ee5a","model":"auto_model/urm","role":"assistant","stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"type":"message","usage":{"input_tokens":2292,"cache_creation_input_tokens":0,"cache_read_input_tokens":78648,"output_tokens":2283,"output_tokens_details":{"thinking_tokens":0},"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"","iterations":[],"speed":"standard"},"stop_details":null},"wireToolInputs":{"call_zuzszlztlotgakoq89oo80g0":{"content":"package 2; k++) v *= k;","         return v;"]}],"originalFile":"package joinopt;\n\nimport java.util.ArrayList;\nimport java.util.LinkedHashMap;\nimport java.util.List;\nimport java.util.Map;\n\n/**\n * 合法连接顺序穷举器（仅用于小规模校验，n ≤ 6）。\n *\n * 递归枚举一个子集 S 的所有<b>二叉连接树</b>：\n * <pre>\n *   |S| = 1 -> 只有扫描叶子\n *   |S| > 1 -> 枚举所有非空真子集 L ⊂ S（L 含 S 最低位），\n *              递归得到 L、R 的全部树，两两组合成一个上层连接节点；\n *              跨 L/R 有等值谓词 -> hashjoin，否则 -> cartesian\n * </pre>\n * 树的总数为 (2n-2)! / (n-1)!（n=6 时 30,240 棵），可在毫秒级穷举完成。\n *\n * 因为 {@link Estimator} 的基数估计与顺序无关，同一掩码的所有候选树根节点\n * estRows 完全相同，差异只来自“哪个中间结果被物化为上层输入”——即代价模型\n * 对树形状的选择。穷举得到的最小代价应与 {@link Optimizer} 的 DP 结果一致。\n */\npublic final class Enumerator {\n\n    public static final int ENUM_LIMIT = 6;\n\n    private final List<Table> tables;\n    private final Estimator estimator;\n    private final java.util.Map<Integer, List<PlanNode>> memo = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n\n    public Enumerator(List<Table> tables, List<JoinPred> preds) {\n        this.tables = tables;\n        this.estimator = new Estimator(tables, preds);\n    }\n\n    /** 一个子集的全部合法计划。 */\n    public List<PlanNode> enumerate(int mask) {\n        List<PlanNode> cached = memo.get(mask);\n        if (cached != null) return cached;\n        List<PlanNode> result = enumerateUncached(mask);\n        memo.put(mask, result);\n        return result;\n    }\n\n    private List<PlanNode> enumerateUncached(int mask) {\n        int n = Integer.bitCount(mask);\n        if (n == 1) {\n            int t = Integer.numberOfTrailingZeros(mask);\n            List<PlanNode> one = new ArrayList<>();\n            PlanNode leaf = PlanNode.leaf(t, tables.get(t).rowCount);\n            leaf.estRows = tables.get(t).rowCount;\n            leaf.cost = 0;\n            one.add(leaf);\n            return one;\n        }\n\n        List<PlanNode> result = new ArrayList<>();\n        int lowest = mask & -mask;\n        int rest = mask ^ lowest;\n        for (int lSub = rest; ; lSub = (lSub - 1) & rest) {\n            int leftMask = lowest | lSub;\n            int rightMask = mask ^ leftMask;\n\n            if (rightMask != 0) {\n                // 子节点朝向与 DP 保持同一约定：较小表编号在左\n                boolean swap = Integer.numberOfTrailingZeros(leftMask)\n                        > Integer.numberOfTrailingZeros(rightMask);\n                int lm = swap ? rightMask : leftMask;\n                int rm = swap ? leftMask : rightMask;\n\n                List<JoinPred> crossing = estimator.crossingPreds(lm, rm);\n                boolean cartesian = crossing.isEmpty();\n                Stats ls = estimator.estimate(lm);\n                Stats rs = estimator.estimate(rm);\n                double outRows = estimator.joinRows(ls, rs, lm, rm, crossing);\n\n                for (PlanNode l : enumerate(lm)) {\n                    for (PlanNode r : enumerate(rm)) {\n                        double nodeCost = PlanNode.nodeCost(\n                                cartesian ? PlanNode.CARTESIAN : PlanNode.HASH_JOIN,\n                                l.estRows, r.estRows, outRows);\n                        PlanNode p = PlanNode.join(cartesian, mask, crossing, l, r,\n                                outRows, l.cost + r.cost + nodeCost);\n                        result.add(p);\n                    }\n                }\n            }\n            if (lSub == 0) break;\n        }\n        return result;\n    }\n\n    /** 穷举结果汇总。 */\n    public static final class Report {\n        public final int totalTrees;\n        public final double minCost;\n        public final double maxCost;\n        public final int optimalCount;\n        public final PlanNode anOptimalPlan;\n\n        Report(int totalTrees, double minCost, double maxCost,\n               int optimalCount, PlanNode anOptimalPlan) {\n            this.totalTrees = totalTrees;\n            this.minCost = minCost;\n            this.maxCost = maxCost;\n            this.optimalCount = optimalCount;\n            this.anOptimalPlan = anOptimalPlan;\n        }\n\n        public Map<String, Object> toJson() {\n            Map<String, Object> m = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n            m.put(\"totalTrees\", totalTrees);\n            m.put(\"minCost\", clean(minCost));\n            m.put(\"maxCost\", clean(maxCost));\n            m.put(\"optimalCount\", optimalCount);\n            m.put(\"anOptimalPlan\", anOptimalPlan == null ? null : \"见外层 plan\");\n            return m;\n        }\n\n        private static Object clean(double d) {\n            if (d == Math.rint(d) && !Double.isInfinite(d)) return (long) d;\n            return d;\n        }\n    }\n\n    /** 穷举全部表并汇总最小代价等信息。 */\n    public Report fullReport() {\n        if (tables.size() > ENUM_LIMIT) {\n            throw new IllegalArgumentException(\"穷举仅支持 ≤ \" + ENUM_LIMIT + \" 张表\");\n        }\n        int full = (1 << tables.size()) - 1;\n        List<PlanNode> all = enumerate(full);\n        double min = Double.POSITIVE_INFINITY;\n        double max = Double.NEGATIVE_INFINITY;\n        PlanNode bestOne = null;\n        for (PlanNode p : all) {\n            if (p.cost < min) { min = p.cost; bestOne = p; }\n            if (p.cost > max) max = p.cost;\n        }\n        int ties = 0;\n        for (PlanNode p : all) {\n            if (p.cost == min) ties++;\n        }\n        return new Report(all.size(), min, max, ties, bestOne);\n    }\n\n    /** 二叉连接树总数的理论值 (2n-2)!/(n-1)!，用于和穷举计数对照。 */\n    public static long expectedTreeCount(int n) {\n        long v = 1;\n        for (int k = n; k <= 2 * n - 2; k++) v *= k;\n        return v;\n    }\n}\n","userModified":false},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"9d3781d2-542c-44cb-b78b-829379fabf90","session_id":"90b11851-b85c-4121-bed4-1de860a4594d","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp17/b","sessionId":"90b11851-b85c-4121-bed4-1de860a4594d","version":"2.1.280","gitBranch":"ab/run-20260922T151547Z/opp17-b","slug":"streamed-doodling-badger"}

? 0 : v;\n    }","originalFile":"package joinopt;\n\nimport java.util.ArrayList;\nimport java.util.LinkedHashMap;\nimport java.util.List;\nimport java.util.Map;\n\n/**\n * 合法连接顺序穷举器（仅用于小规模校验，n ≤ 6）。\n *\n * 递归枚举一个可达子集 S 的所有<b>二叉连接树</b>（左右子节点有序）：\n * <pre>\n *   |S| = 1 -> 只有扫描叶子\n *   |S| > 1 -> 枚举所有无向真分区（一侧含 S 最低位）；\n *              对每个合法分区，递归 L、R 全部树，\n *              并分别以 (L,R) 与 (R,L) 两种朝向组合上层节点\n * </pre>\n * 合法性判定与 DP 完全一致（见 {@link Components}）：\n * 连通子集的分区必须有跨边（哈希连接）；跨分量分区两侧必须是完整分量之并\n * （笛卡尔积）。不可达子集没有任何计划。\n *\n * 无任何谓词时，n 个表的合法树总数为 (2n-2)!/(n-1)!：\n * n=1..6 依次为 1, 2, 12, 120, 1680, 30240。穷举结果用于校验\n * {@link Optimizer} 的 DP 找到的最小代价与全局最小值完全一致。\n */\npublic final class Enumerator {\n\n    public static final int ENUM_LIMIT = 6;\n\n    private final List<Table> tables;\n    private final Estimator estimator;\n    private final Components components;\n    private final Map<Integer, List<PlanNode>> memo = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n\n    public Enumerator(List<Table> tables, List<JoinPred> preds) {\n        this.tables = tables;\n        this.estimator = new Estimator(tables, preds);\n        this.components = new Components(tables.size(), preds);\n    }\n\n    /** 一个子集的全部合法计划；不可达子集返回空列表。 */\n    public List<PlanNode> enumerate(int mask) {\n        if (memo.containsKey(mask)) return memo.get(mask);\n        List<PlanNode> result = enumerateUncached(mask);\n        memo.put(mask, result);\n        return result;\n    }\n\n    private List<PlanNode> enumerateUncached(int mask) {\n        if (Integer.bitCount(mask) == 1) {\n            int t = Integer.numberOfTrailingZeros(mask);\n            List<PlanNode> one = new ArrayList<>();\n            PlanNode leaf = PlanNode.leaf(t, tables.get(t).rowCount);\n            leaf.estRows = tables.get(t).rowCount;\n            leaf.cost = 0;\n            one.add(leaf);\n            return one;\n        }\n\n        List<PlanNode> result = new ArrayList<>();\n        int lowest = mask & -mask;\n        int rest = mask ^ lowest;\n        for (int lSub = rest; ; lSub = (lSub - 1) & rest) {\n            int aMask = lowest | lSub;\n            int bMask = mask ^ aMask;\n            if (bMask != 0) {\n                List<PlanPred> aPlans = wrap(enumerate(aMask));\n                List<PlanPred> bPlans = wrap(enumerate(bMask));\n                if (!aPlans.isEmpty() && !bPlans.isEmpty()) {\n                    List<JoinPred> crossing = estimator.crossingPreds(aMask, bMask);\n                    if (components.legalSplit(aMask, bMask, !crossing.isEmpty())) {\n                        // 两种朝向：(A 在左,B 在右) 与 (B 在左,A 在右)\n                        addCombos(result, mask, aPlans, bPlans, aMask, bMask, crossing);\n                        addCombos(result, mask, bPlans, aPlans, bMask, aMask, crossing);\n                    }\n                }\n            }\n            if (lSub == 0) break;\n        }\n        return result;\n    }\n\n    /** 携带自身掩码的计划包装，便于组合时取对侧列。 */\n    private static final class PlanPred {\n        final PlanNode node;\n        PlanPred(PlanNode node) { this.node = node; }\n    }\n\n    private List<PlanPred> wrap(List<PlanNode> nodes) {\n        List<PlanPred> out = new ArrayList<>(nodes.size());\n        for (PlanNode n : nodes) out.add(new PlanPred(n));\n        return out;\n    }\n\n    private void addCombos(List<PlanNode> out, int mask,\n                           List<PlanPred> lefts, List<PlanPred> rights,\n                           int leftMask, int rightMask, List<JoinPred> crossing) {\n        boolean cartesian = crossing.isEmpty();\n        Stats ls = estimator.estimate(leftMask);\n        Stats rs = estimator.estimate(rightMask);\n        double outRows = estimator.joinRows(ls, rs, leftMask, rightMask, crossing);\n        for (PlanPred l : lefts) {\n            for (PlanPred r : rights) {\n                double nodeCost = PlanNode.nodeCost(\n                        cartesian ? PlanNode.CARTESIAN : PlanNode.HASH_JOIN,\n                        l.node.estRows, r.node.estRows, outRows);\n                out.add(PlanNode.join(cartesian, mask, crossing,\n                        l.node, r.node, outRows, l.node.cost + r.node.cost + nodeCost));\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    /** 穷举结果汇总。 */\n    public static final class Report {\n        public final int totalTrees;\n        public final double minCost;\n        public final double maxCost;\n        public final int optimalCount;\n        public final PlanNode anOptimalPlan;\n        public final long expectedTreeCount;\n\n        Report(int totalTrees, double minCost, double maxCost, int optimalCount,\n               PlanNode anOptimalPlan, long expectedTreeCount) {\n            this.totalTrees = totalTrees;\n            this.minCost = minCost;\n            this.maxCost = maxCost;\n            this.optimalCount = optimalCount;\n            this.anOptimalPlan = anOptimalPlan;\n            this.expectedTreeCount = expectedTreeCount;\n        }\n\n        public Map<String, Object> toJson() {\n            Map<String, Object> m = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n            m.put(\"totalTrees\", totalTrees);\n            m.put(\"expectedTreeCount\", expectedTreeCount);\n            m.put(\"minCost\", clean(minCost));\n            m.put(\"maxCost\", clean(maxCost));\n            m.put(\"optimalCount\", optimalCount);\n            return m;\n        }\n\n        private static Object clean(double d) {\n            if (d == Math.rint(d) && !Double.isInfinite(d)) return (long) d;\n            return d;\n        }\n    }\n\n    /** 穷举全部表并汇总最小代价等信息。 */\n    public Report fullReport() {\n        if (tables.size() > ENUM_LIMIT) {\n            throw new IllegalArgumentException(\"穷举仅支持 ≤ \" + ENUM_LIMIT + \" 张表\");\n        }\n        int full = (1 << tables.size()) - return v == null ? 0 : v;\n    }","originalFile":"package joinopt;\n\nimport java.util.ArrayList;\nimport java.util.LinkedHashMap;\nimport java.util.List;\nimport java.util.Map;\n\n/**\n * 合法连接顺序穷举器（仅用于小规模校验，n ≤ 6）。\n *\n * 递归枚举一个可达子集 S 的所有<b>二叉连接树</b>（左右子节点有序）：\n * <pre>\n *   |S| = 1 -> 只有扫描叶子\n *   |S| > 1 -> 枚举所有无向真分区（一侧含 S 最低位）；\n *              对每个合法分区，递归 L、R 全部树，\n *              并分别以 (L,R) 与 (R,L) 两种朝向组合上层节点\n * </pre>\n * 合法性判定与 DP 完全一致（见 {@link Components}）：\n * 连通子集的分区必须有跨边（哈希连接）；跨分量分区两侧必须是完整分量之并\n * （笛卡尔积）。不可达子集没有任何计划。\n *\n * 无任何谓词时，n 个表的合法树总数为 (2n-2)!/(n-1)!：\n * n=1..6 依次为 1, 2, 12, 120, 1680, 30240。穷举结果用于校验\n * {@link Optimizer} 的 DP 找到的最小代价与全局最小值完全一致。\n */\npublic final class Enumerator {\n\n    public static final int ENUM_LIMIT = 6;\n\n    private final List<Table> tables;\n    private final Estimator estimator;\n    private final Components components;\n    private final Map<Integer, List<PlanNode>> memo = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n\n    public Enumerator(List<Table> tables, List<JoinPred> preds) {\n        this.tables = tables;\n        this.estimator = new Estimator(tables, preds);\n        this.components = new Components(tables.size(), preds);\n    }\n\n    /** 一个子集的全部合法计划；不可达子集返回空列表。 */\n    public List<PlanNode> enumerate(int mask) {\n        if (memo.containsKey(mask)) return memo.get(mask);\n        List<PlanNode> result = enumerateUncached(mask);\n        memo.put(mask, result);\n        return result;\n    }\n\n    private List<PlanNode> enumerateUncached(int mask) {\n        if (Integer.bitCount(mask) == 1) {\n            int t = Integer.numberOfTrailingZeros(mask);\n            List<PlanNode> one = new ArrayList<>();\n            PlanNode leaf = PlanNode.leaf(t, tables.get(t).rowCount);\n            leaf.estRows = tables.get(t).rowCount;\n            leaf.cost = 0;\n            one.add(leaf);\n            return one;\n        }\n\n        List<PlanNode> result = new ArrayList<>();\n        int lowest = mask & -mask;\n        int rest = mask ^ lowest;\n        for (int lSub = rest; ; lSub = (lSub - 1) & rest) {\n            int aMask = lowest | lSub;\n            int bMask = mask ^ aMask;\n            if (bMask != 0) {\n                List<PlanPred> aPlans = wrap(enumerate(aMask));\n                List<PlanPred> bPlans = wrap(enumerate(bMask));\n                if (!aPlans.isEmpty() && !bPlans.isEmpty()) {\n                    List<JoinPred> crossing = estimator.crossingPreds(aMask, bMask);\n                    if (components.legalSplit(aMask, bMask, !crossing.isEmpty())) {\n                        // 两种朝向：(A 在左,B 在右) 与 (B 在左,A 在右)\n                        addCombos(result, mask, aPlans, bPlans, aMask, bMask, crossing);\n                        addCombos(result, mask, bPlans, aPlans, bMask, aMask, crossing);\n                    }\n                }\n            }\n            if (lSub == 0) break;\n        }\n        return result;\n    }\n\n    /** 携带自身掩码的计划包装，便于组合时取对侧列。 */\n    private static final class PlanPred {\n        final PlanNode node;\n        PlanPred(PlanNode node) { this.node = node; }\n    }\n\n    private List<PlanPred> wrap(List<PlanNode> nodes) {\n        List<PlanPred> out = new ArrayList<>(nodes.size());\n        for (PlanNode n : nodes) out.add(new PlanPred(n));\n        return out;\n    }\n\n    private void addCombos(List<PlanNode> out, int mask,\n                           List<PlanPred> lefts, List<PlanPred> rights,\n                           int leftMask, int rightMask, List<JoinPred> crossing) {\n        boolean cartesian = crossing.isEmpty();\n        Stats ls = estimator.estimate(leftMask);\n        Stats rs = estimator.estimate(rightMask);\n        double outRows = estimator.joinRows(ls, rs, leftMask, rightMask, java.util.Map;\n\n/**\n * 全套自动化测试（零依赖，直接 main 运行）。\n * 覆盖：JSON 往返、基数估计、DP 最优性、穷举一致性、断开图/笛卡尔积、\n * 执行器语义、倾斜失准、顺序不变性、NULL 语义、多谓词哈希连接、端到端入口、导出、输入校验。\n */\npublic final class AllTests {\n\n    private static int passed = 0;\n    private static final List<String> failed = new ArrayList<>();\n\n    public static void main(String[] args) {\n        String[] names = {\n                \"jsonParseAndSerializeRoundTrip\",\n                \"jsonHandlesNumbersStringsNullEscape\",\n                \"tableNdvComputedFromDataAndCapped\",\n                \"cardinalityEstimationTextbookFormula\",\n                \"estimationIsOrderIndependent\",\n                \"dpPicksMinCostPlan_chain\",\n                \"dpMatchesExhaustiveEnumeration\",\n                \"legalTreeCountMatchesFormula\",\n                \"disconnectedGraphMarksCartesianAndSemantics\",\n                \"executorHashJoinSemantics\",\n                \"executorMultiPredicateJoin\",\n                \"nullKeysDoNotMatch\",\n                \"numericStringCanonicalization\",\n                \"skewedStatsEstimateVsActual\",\n                \"nestedLoopCartesianSemantics\",\n                \"statsOnlySkipsExecution\",\n                \"maxTablesLimit\",\n                \"endToEndHandlerAndExport\",\n                \"badRequestsFail\",\n                \"zeroRowTable\",\n        };\n        for (String name : names) {\n            try {\n                AllTests.class.getDeclaredMethod(name).invoke(null);\n     failed.add(name);\n                System.out.println(\"FAIL \" + name + \" :: \" + cause);\n            }\n        }\n        System.out.println();\n        System.out.println(\"通过 \" + passed + \" / \" + names.length);\n        if (!failed.isEmpty()) {\n            System.out.println(\"失败用例: \" + failed);\n            System.exit(1);\n        }\n    }\n\n    // ---------- 1. JSON ----------\n\n    static void jsonParseAndSerializeRoundTrip() {\n        String s = \"{\\\"a\\\":1,\\\"b\\\":[true,false,null,\\\"x y\\\"],\\\"c\\\":{\\\"d\\\":-2.5}}\";\n        Object v = Json.parse(s);\n        Map<String, Object> m = Json.asObj(v);\n        TestFramework.eq(Json.lng(m, \"a\"), 1L, \"字段 a\");\n        TestFramework.eq(Json.asArr(m.get(\"b\")).get(0), Boolean.TRUE, \"布尔\");\n        TestFramework.eq(Json.asArr(m.get(\"b\")).get(2), null, \"null 字面量\");\n        String again = Json.pretty(v);\n        Object v2 = Json.parse(again);\n        TestFramework.check(v.equals(v2), \"JSON 往返后结构应一致\");\n    }\n\n    static void jsonHandlesNumbersStringsNullEscape() {\n        Map<String, Object> m = TestFramework.obj(\"{\\\"n\\\":1,\\\"f\\\":1.0,\\\"s\\\":\\\"a\\\\tb\\\\nc\\\"}\");\n        TestFramework.check(m.get(\"n\") instanceof Long, \"整数解析为 Long\");\n        TestFramework.check(m.get(\"f\") instanceof Double, \"小数解析为 Double\");\n        TestFramework.eq(m.get(\"s\"), \"a\\tb\\nc\", \"转义字符\");\n        String pretty = Json.pretty(m);\n        TestFramework.check(Json.parse(pretty).equals(m), \"转义后往返一致\");\n    }\n\n    // ---------- 2. 表统计 ----------\n\n    static void tableNdvComputedFromDataAndCapped() {\n        List<String> w = new ArrayList<>();\n        String req = \"{\\\"tables\\\":[{\\\"name\\\":\\\"t\\\",\\\"columns\\\":[\\\"k\\\",\\\"v\\\"],\\\"rows\\\":[[1,\\\"a\\\"],[1,\\\"b\\\"],[2,\\\"c\\\"]]}]}\";\n        List<Table> ts = TestFramework.tables(req, w);\n        Table t = ts.get(0);\n        TestFramework.eq(t.rowCount, 3L, \"实际行数\");\n        TestFramework.eq(t.ndv.get(\"k\"), 2L, \"k 的 NDV\");\n        TestFramework.eq(t.ndv.get(\"v\"), 3L, \"v 的 NDV\");\n\n        List<String> w2 = new ArrayList<>();\n        String req2 = \"{\\\"tables\\\":[{\\\"name\\\":\\\"t\\\",\\\"columns\\\":[\\\"k\\\"],\\\"rowCount\\\":5,\\\"ndv\\\":{\\\"k\\\":9}}]}\";\n        Table t2 = TestFramework.tables(req2, w2).get(0);\n        TestFramework.eq(t2.ndv.get(\"k\"), 5L, \"NDV 超过行数应截断\");\n        TestFramework.check(!w2.isEmpty(), \"截断应产生告警\");\n        TestFramework.check(t2.statsOnly, \"无 rows 为仅统计表\");\n    }\n\n    // ---------- 3. 估计 ----------\n\n    /** 构造仅统计表。 */\n    private static List<Table> statsTables(String names, long[] rows, long[]... ndvs) {\n        List<String> w = new ArrayList<>();\n        StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder(\"{\\\"tables\\\":[\");\n        String[] nm = names.split(\",\");\n        for (int i = 0; i < nm.length; i++) {\n            if (i > 0) sb.append(',');\n            sb.append(\"{\\\"name\\\":\\\"\").append(nm[i]).append(\"\\\",\\\"columns\\\":[\\\"id\\\"]\");\n            if (i < ndvs.length) sb.append(\",\\\"rowCount\\\":\").append(rows[i])\n                    .append(\",\\\"ndv\\\":{\\\"id\\\":\").append(ndvs[i][0]).append(\"}\");\n            sb.append('}');\n        }\n        sb.append(\"]}\");\n        return TestFramework.tables(sb.toString(), w);\n    }\n\n    /** 带指定列名/NDV 的统计表。 */\n    private static Table statTable(String name, String[] cols, long rows, long... colNdv) {\n        List<String> w = new ArrayList<>();\n        StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder(\"{\\\"name\\\":\\\"\").append(name)\n                .append(\"\\\",\\\"columns\\\":[\");\n        for (int i = 0; i < cols.length; i++) {\n            if (i > 0) sb.append(',');\n            sb.append('\"').append(cols[i]).append('\"');\n        }\n        sb.append(\"],\\\"rowCount\\\":\").append(rows).append(\",\\\"ndv\\\":{\");\n        for (int i = 0; i < cols.length; i++) {\n            if (i > 0) sb.append(',');\n            sb.append('\"').append(cols[i]).append(\"\\\":\").append(colNdv[i]);\n        }\n        sb.append(\"}}\");\n        return Table.fromJson(TestFramework.obj(sb.toString()), w);\n    }\n\n    static void cardinalityEstimationTextbookFormula() {\n        // a(1000, ndv id=1000, b_id=100) ⋈ b(100, ndv id=100) => 1000\n        Table a = statTable(\"a\", new String[]{\"id\", \"b_id\"}, 1000, 1000, 100);\n        Table b = statTable(\"b\", new String[]{\"id\"}, 100, 100);\n        List<Table> ts = Arrays.asList(a, b);\n        List<JoinPred> ps = Arrays.asList(new JoinPred(0, \"b_id\", 1, \"id\"));\n        Estimator est = new Estimator(ts, ps);\n        Stats s = est.estimate(0b11);\n        TestFramework.approx(s.rows, 1000.0, 1e-9, \"两表估计行数 = |a||b|/max(100,100)\");\n        TestFramework.eq(s.ndv.get(\"a.b_id\"), 100L, \"结果列 NDV 不超行数\");\n    }\n\n    static void estimationIsOrderIndependent() {\n        // 3 表链：同一子集的估计无论怎么切分，joinRows 复算结果必须一致\n        Table a = statTable(\"a\", new String[]{\"id\", \"b_id\"}, 100000, 100000, 1000);\n        Table b = statTable(\"b\", new String[]{\"id\", \"c_id\"}, 1000, 1000, 100);\n        Table c = statTable(\"c\", new String[]{\"id\"}, 100, 100);\n        List<Table> ts = Arrays.asList(a, b, c);\n        List<JoinPred> ps = Arrays.asList(\n                new JoinPred(0, \"b_id\", 1, \"id\"),\n                new JoinPred(1, \"c_id\", 2, \"id\"));\n        Estimator est = new Estimator(ts, ps);\n\n        double whole = est.estimate(0b111).rows;\n        // (a⋈b)⋈c\n        double ab = est.estimate(0b011).rows;\n        double v1 = est.joinRows(new Stats(ab, new LinkedHashMap<>()), est.estimate(0b100),\n                0b011, 0b100, est.crossingPreds(0b011, 0b100));\n        // (b⋈c)⋈a\n        double bc = est.estimate(0b110).rows;\n        double v2 = est.joinRows(new Stats(bc, new LinkedHashMap<>()), est.estimate(0b001),\n                0b110, 0b001, est.crossingPreds(0b110, 0b001));\n        TestFramework.approx(v1, whole, 1e-6, \"(ab)c 与整体估计一致\");\n        TestFramework.approx(v2, whole, 1e-6, \"a(bc) 与整体估计一致\");\n        TestFramework.approx(whole, 100000.0, 1e-6, \"链三表最终估计=100000\");\n    }\n\n    // ---------- 4. DP 与穷举 ----------\n\n    static void dpPicksMinCostPlan_chain() {\n        Table a = statTable(\"a\", new String[]{\"id\", \"b_id\"}, 100000, 100000, 1000);\n        Table b = statTable(\"b\", new String[]{\"id\", \"c_id\"}, 1000, 1000, 100);\n        Table c = statTable(\"c\", new String[]{\"id\", \"d_id\"}, 100, 100, 10);\n        Table d = statTable(\"d\", new String[]{\"id\"}, 10, 10);\n        List<Table> ts = Arrays.asList(a, b, c, d);\n        List<JoinPred> ps = Arrays.asList(\n                new JoinPred(0, \"b_id\", 1, \"id\"),\n                new JoinPred(1, \"c_id\", 2, \"id\"),\n                new JoinPred(2, \"d_id\", 3, \"id\"));\n        Optimizer opt = new Optimizer(ts, ps);\n        PlanNode plan = opt.bestPlan();\n        // 小表一侧先连：最内层 c⋈d，再 b，再 a\n        TestFramework.eq(plan.rounded(), 100000L, \"根估计行数\");\n        TestFramework.check(plan.left.tableIdx == 0 || plan.right.tableIdx == 0\n                || containsScan(plan, 0), \"计划含 a 扫描\");\n        // 最优计划最内层必须是 c-d 连接（估计 100 行，代价最低起点）\n        String canon = plan.canonical(ts);\n        TestFramework.check(canon.startsWith(\"J\"), \"根为连接节点\");\n        TestFramework.approx(plan.cost, 203310.0, 1e-9, \"总代价与手算一致\");\n    }\n\n    private static boolean containsScan(PlanNode n, int t) {\n        if (n.isLeaf()) return n.tableIdx == t;\n        return containsScan(n.left, t) || containsScan(n.right, t);\n    }\n\n    static void dpMatchesExhaustiveEnumeration() {\n        // 多张随机风格查询（链、星、环、断开），DP 最优代价必须等于穷举最小代价\n        int[][][] graphCases = {\n                {{0, 1}, {1, 2}, {2, 3}},                       // 链 4\n                {{0, 1}, {0, 2}, {0, 3}},                       // 星 4\n                {{0, 1}, {1, 2}, {2, 0}, {2, 3}},               // 环+尾 4\n                {{0, 1}, {2, 3}},                               // 断开 4\n                {{0, 1}, {0, 2}, {0, 3}, {0, 4}, {1, 5}},       // 6 表\n                {},                                              // 全笛卡尔 4\n        };\n        int[] sizes = {4, 4, 4, 4, 6, 4};\n        long seed = 42;\n        for (int ci = 0; ci < graphCases.length; ci++) {\n            int n = sizes[ci];\n            List<Table> ts = new ArrayList<>();\n            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {\n                // 伪随机行数与 NDV，避免退化\n                seed = (seed * 1103515245 + 12345) & 0x7fffffff;\n                long rows = 10 + seed % 5000;\n                long ndv = 1 + seed % rows;\n                List<String> cols = new ArrayList<>();\n                List<Long> nd = new ArrayList<>();\n                cols.add(\"id\"); nd.add(rows);\n                for (int[] e : graphCases[ci]) {\n                    if (e[0] == i || e[1] == i) {\n                        int other = e[0] == i ? e[1] : e[0];\n                        String col = \"fk\" + other;\n                        cols.add(col);\n                        seed = (seed * 1103515245 + 12345) & 0x7fffffff;\n                        nd.add(1 + seed % Math.max(1, rows));\n                    }\n                }\n                Table t = statTable(\"t\" + i, cols.toArray(new String[0]),\n                        rows, nd.stream().mapToLong(Long::longValue).toArray());\n                ts.add(t);\n            }\n            List<JoinPred> ps = new ArrayList<>();\n            for (int[] e : graphCases[ci]) {\n                int x = e[0], y = e[1];\n                String cx = \"fk\" + y, cy = \"id\";\n                ps.add(new JoinPred(x, cx, y, cy));\n            }\n            Optimizer opt = new Optimizer(ts, ps);\n            Enumerator en = new Enumerator(ts, ps);\n            Enumerator.Report rep = en.fullReport();\n            TestFramework.approx(opt.bestPlan().cost, rep.minCost, 1e-6,\n                    \"case \" + ci + \" DP 代价 == 穷举最小\");\n            TestFramework.check(rep.totalTrees == rep.expectedTreeCount,\n                    \"case \" + ci + \" 穷举树数 \" + rep.totalTrees + \" == 精确公式 \" + rep.expectedTreeCount);\n        }\n    }\n\n    static void legalTreeCountMatchesFormula() {\n        // 无边 n 表：每个分量单表，合法树数 = (2n-2)!/(n-1)!，n=1..6\n        long[] expected = {1, 2, 12, 120, 1680, 30240};\n        for (int n = 1; n <= 6; n++) {\n            List<Table> ts = new ArrayList<>();\n            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) ts.add(statTable(\"t\" + i, new String[]{\"id\"}, 10, 10));\n            Enumerator en = new Enumerator(ts, new ArrayList<>());\n            Enumerator.Report rep = en.fullReport();\n            TestFramework.eq((long) rep.totalTrees, expected[n - 1],\n ts = new ArrayList<>();\n        for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) ts.add(statTable(\"t\" + i, new String[]{\"id\"}, 10, 10));\n        List<JoinPred> ps = Arrays.asList(\n                new JoinPred(0, \"id\", 1, \"id\"),\n                new JoinPred(1, \"id\", 2, \"id\"),\n                new JoinPred(2, \"id\", 3, \"id\"));\n        Enumerator.Report rep = new Enumerator(ts, ps).fullReport();\n        TestFramework.eq((long) rep.totalTrees, 120L, \"4 表连通链也是 120 棵\");\n    }\n\n    // ---------- 5. 断开图与笛卡尔积 ----------\n\n    static void disconnectedGraphMarksCartesianAndSemantics() {\n \"{\\\"name\\\":\\\"a\\\",\\\"columns\\\":[\\\"id\\\"],\\\"rows\\\":[[1]]},\"\n                + \"{\\\"name\\\":\\\"b\\\",\\\"columns\\\":[\\\"id\\\"],\\\"rows\\\":[[1]]}],\"\n                + \"\\\"joins\\\":[[\\\"a\\\",\\\"nope\\\",\\\"b\\\",\\\"id\\\"]]}\", \"谓词引用不存在的列\");\n        expectError(\"{\\\"tables\\\":[\"\n                + \"{\\\"name\\\":\\\"a\\\",\\\"columns\\\":[\\\"id\\\"],\\\"rows\\\":[[1,2]]}]}\", \"数据行列数不符\");\n    }\n\n    private static void expectError(String req, String label) {\n        boolean threw = false;\n        try {\n            new Main.Handler().handle(TestFramework.obj(req), null);\n        } catch (RuntimeException e) {\n            threw = true;\n        }\n        TestFramework.check(threw, \"应报错: \" + label);\n    }\n\n    static void zeroRowTable() {\n        String req = \"{\\\"tables\\\":[\"\n                + \"{\\\"name\\\":\\\"a\\\",\\\"columns\\\":[\\\"k\\\"],\\\"rows\\\":[]},\"\n                + \"{\\\"name\\\":\\\"b\\\",\\\"columns\\\":[\\\"k\\\"],\\\"rows\\\":[[1],[2]]}\"\n                + \"],\\\"joins\\\":[[\\\"a\\\",\\\"k\\\",\\\"b\\\",\\\"k\\\"]]}\";\n        List<String> w = new ArrayList<>();\n        List<Table> ts = TestFramework.tables(req, w);\n        List<JoinPred> ps = TestFramework.preds(req, ts, w);\n        PlanNode plan = new Optimizer(ts, ps).bestPlan();\n        TestFramework.eq(plan.rounded(), 0L, \"含空表时估计 0 行\");\n        Rel r = new Executor(ts).execute(plan);\n        TestFramework.eq((long) r.rows.size(), 0L, \"实际 0 行\");\n    }\n}\n"},"name":"Write","type":"tool_use"}],"id":"msg_d50555060928d679847d0ad9","model":"auto_model/urm","role":"assistant","stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"type":"message","usage":{"input_tokens":1413,"cache_creation_input_tokens":0,"cache_read_input_tokens":86840,"output_tokens":7887,"output_tokens_details":{"thinking_tokens":0},"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"","iterations":[],"speed":"standard"},"stop_details":null},"wireToolInputs":{"call_qrib327rydzdzd704d2kdf7o":{"content":"package joinopt;\n\nimport java.nio.file.Files;\nimport java.nio.file.Path;\nimport java.util.ArrayList;\nimport java.util.Arrays;\nimport java.util.LinkedHashMap;\nimport java.util.List;\nimport java.util.Map;\n\n/**\n * 全套自动化测试（零依赖，直接 main 运行）。\n * 覆盖：JSON 往返、基数估计、DP 最优性、穷举一致性、断开图/笛卡尔积、\n * 执行器语义、倾斜失准、顺序不变性、NULL 语义、多谓词哈希连接、端到端入口、导出、输入校验。\n */\npublic final class AllTests {\n\n    private static int passed = 0;\n    private static final List<String> failed = new ArrayList<>();\n\n    public static void main(String[] args) {\n        String[] names = {\n                \"jsonParseAndSerializeRoundTrip\",\n                \"jsonHandlesNumbersStringsNullEscape\",\n                \"tableNdvComputedFromDataAndCapped\",\n                \"cardinalityEstimationTextbookFormula\",\n                \"estimationIsOrderIndependent\",\n                \"dpPicksMinCostPlan_chain\",\n                \"dpMatchesExhaustiveEnumeration\",\n                \"legalTreeCountMatchesFormula\",\n                \"disconnectedGraphMarksCartesianAndSemantics\",\n                \"executorHashJoinSemantics\",\n                \"executorMultiPredicateJoin\",\n                \"nullKeysDoNotMatch\",\n                \"numericStringCanonicalization\",\n                \"skewedStatsEstimateVsActual\",\n                \"nestedLoopCartesianSemantics\",\n                \"statsOnlySkipsExecution\",\n                \"maxTablesLimit\",\n                \"endToEndHandlerAndExport\",\n                \"badRequestsFail\",\n                \"zeroRowTable\",\n        };\n        for (String name : names) {\n            try {\n                AllTests.class.getDeclaredMethod(name).invoke(null);\n                passed++;\n                System.out.println(\"PASS \" + name);\n            } catch (Throwable t) {\n                Throwable cause = t.getCause() != null ? t.getCause() : t;\n                failed.add(name);\n                System.out.println(\"FAIL \" + name + \" :: \" + cause);\n            }\n        }\n        System.out.println();\n        System.out.println(\"通过 \" + passed + \" / \" + names.length);\n        if (!failed.isEmpty()) {\n            System.out.println(\"失败用例: \" + failed);\n            System.exit(1);\n        }\n    }\n\n    // ---------- 1. JSON ----------\n\n    static void jsonParseAndSerializeRoundTrip() {\n        String s = \"{\\\"a\\\":1,\\\"b\\\":[true,false,null,\\\"x y\\\"],\\\"c\\\":{\\\"d\\\":-2.5}}\";\n        Object v = Json.parse(s);\n        Map<String, Object> m = Json.asObj(v);\n        TestFramework.eq(Json.lng(m, \"a\"), 1L, \"字段 a\");\n        TestFramework.eq(Json.asArr(m.get(\"b\")).get(0), Boolean.TRUE, \"布尔\");\n        TestFramework.eq(Json.asArr(m.get(\"b\")).get(2), null, \"null 字面量\");\n        String again = Json.pretty(v);\n        Object v2 = Json.parse(again);\n        TestFramework.check(v.equals(v2), \"JSON 往返后结构应一致\");\n    }\n\n    static void jsonHandlesNumbersStringsNullEscape() {\n        Map<String, Object> m = TestFramework.obj(\"{\\\"n\\\":1,\\\"f\\\":1.0,\\\"s\\\":\\\"a\\\\tb\\\\nc\\\"}\");\n        TestFramework.check(m.get(\"n\") instanceof Long, \"整数解析为 Long\");\n        TestFramework.check(m.get(\"f\") instanceof Double, \"小数解析为 Double\");\n        TestFramework.eq(m.get(\"s\"), \"a\\tb\\nc\", \"转义字符\");\n        String pretty = Json.pretty(m);\n        TestFramework.check(Json.parse(pretty).equals(m), \"转义后往返一致\");\n    }\n\n    // ---------- 2. 表统计 ----------\n\n    static void tableNdvComputedFromDataAndCapped() {\n        List<String> w = new ArrayList<>();\n        String req = \"{\\\"tables\\\":[{\\\"name\\\":\\\"t\\\",\\\"columns\\\":[\\\"k\\\",\\\"v\\\"],\\\"rows\\\":[[1,\\\"a\\\"],[1,\\\"b\\\"],[2,\\\"c\\\"]]}]}\";\n        List<Table> ts = TestFramework.tables(req, w);\n        Table t = ts.get(0);\n        TestFramework.eq(t.rowCount, 3L, \"实际行数\");\n        TestFramework.eq(t.ndv.get(\"k\"), 2L, \"k 的 NDV\");\n        TestFramework.eq(t.ndv.get(\"v\"), 3L, \"v 的 NDV\");\n\n        List<String> w2 = new ArrayList<>();\n        String req2 = \"{\\\"tables\\\":[{\\\"name\\\":\\\"t\\\",\\\"columns\\\":[\\\"k\\\"],\\\"rowCount\\\":5,\\\"ndv\\\":{\\\"k\\\":9}}]}\";\n        Table t2 = TestFramework.tables(req2, w2).get(0);\n        TestFramework.eq(t2.ndv.get(\"k\"), 5L, \"NDV 超过行数应截断\");\n        TestFramework.check(!w2.isEmpty(), \"截断应产生告警\");\n        TestFramework.check(t2.statsOnly, \"无 rows 为仅统计表\");\n    }\n\n    // ---------- 3. 估计 ----------\n\n    /** 构造仅统计表。 */\n    private static List<Table> statsTables(String names, long[] rows, long[]... ndvs) {\n        List<String> w = new ArrayList<>();\n        StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder(\"{\\\"tables\\\":[\");\n        String[] nm = names.split(\",\");\n        for (int i = 0; i < nm.length; i++) {\n            if (i > 0) sb.append(',');\n            sb.append(\"{\\\"name\\\":\\\"\").append(nm[i]).append(\"\\\",\\\"columns\\\":[\\\"id\\\"]\");\n            if (i < ndvs.length) sb.append(\",\\\"rowCount\\\":\").append(rows[i])\n                    .append(\",\\\"ndv\\\":{\\\"id\\\":\").append(ndvs[i][0]).append(\"}\");\n            sb.append('}');\n        }\n        sb.append(\"]}\");\n        return TestFramework.tables(sb.toString(), w);\n    }\n\n    /** 带指定列名/NDV 的统计表。 */\n    private static Table statTable(String name, String[] cols, long rows, long... colNdv) {\n        List<String> w = new ArrayList<>();\n        StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder(\"{\\\"name\\\":\\\"\").append(name)\n                .append(\"\\\",\\\"columns\\\":[\");\n        for (int i = 0; i < cols.length; i++) {\n            if (i > 0) sb.append(',');\n            sb.append('\"').append(cols[i]).append('\"');\n        }\n        sb.append(\"],\\\"rowCount\\\":\").append(rows).append(\",\\\"ndv\\\":{\");\n        for (int i = 0; i < cols.length; i++) {\n            if (i > 0) sb.append(',');\n            sb.append('\"').append(cols[i]).append(\"\\\":\").append(colNdv[i]);\n        }\n        sb.append(\"}}\");\n        return Table.fromJson(TestFramework.obj(sb.toString()), w);\n    }\n\n    static void cardinalityEstimationTextbookFormula() {\n        // a(1000, ndv id=1000, b_id=100) ⋈ b(100, ndv id=100) => 1000\n        Table a = statTable(\"a\", new String[]{\"id\", \"b_id\"}, 1000, 1000, 100);\n        Table b = statTable(\"b\", new String[]{\"id\"}, 100, 100);\n        List<Table> ts = Arrays.asList(a, b);\n        List<JoinPred> ps = Arrays.asList(new JoinPred(0, \"b_id\", 1, \"id\"));\n        Estimator est = new Estimator(ts, ps);\n        Stats s = est.estimate(0b11);\n        TestFramework.approx(s.rows, 1000.0, 1e-9, \"两表估计行数 = |a||b|/max(100,100)\");\n        TestFramework.eq(s.ndv.get(\"a.b_id\"), 100L, \"结果列 NDV 不超行数\");\n    }\n\n    static void estimationIsOrderIndependent() {\n        // 3 表链：同一子集的估计无论怎么切分，joinRows 复算结果必须一致\n        Table a = statTable(\"a\", new String[]{\"id\", \"b_id\"}, 100000, 100000, 1000);\n        Table b = statTable(\"b\", new String[]{\"id\", \"c_id\"}, 1000, 1000, 100);\n        Table c = statTable(\"c\", new String[]{\"id\"}, 100, 100);\n        List<Table> ts = Arrays.asList(a, b, c);\n        List<JoinPred> ps = Arrays.asList(\n                new JoinPred(0, \"b_id\", 1, \"id\"),\n                new JoinPred(1, \"c_id\", 2, \"id\"));\n        Estimator est = new Estimator(ts, ps);\n\n        double whole = est.estimate(0b111).rows;\n        // (a⋈b)⋈c\n        double ab = est.estimate(0b011).rows;\n        double v1 = est.joinRows(new Stats(ab, new LinkedHashMap<>()), est.estimate(0b100),\n                0b011, 0b100, est.crossingPreds(0b011, 0b100));\n        // (b⋈c)⋈a\n        double bc = est.estimate(0b110).rows;\n        double v2 = est.joinRows(new Stats(bc, new LinkedHashMap<>()), est.estimate(0b001),\n                0b110, 0b001, est.crossingPreds(0b110, 0b001));\n        TestFramework.approx(v1, whole, 1e-6, \"(ab)c 与整体估计一致\");\n        TestFramework.approx(v2, whole, 1e-6, \"a(bc) 与整体估计一致\");\n        TestFramework.approx(whole, 100000.0, 1e-6, \"链三表最终估计=100000\");\n    }\n\n    // ---------- 4. DP 与穷举 ----------\n\n    static void dpPicksMinCostPlan_chain() {\n        Table a = statTable(\"a\", new String[]{\"id\", \"b_id\"}, 100000, 100000, 1000);\n        Table b = statTable(\"b\", new String[]{\"id\", \"c_id\"}, 1000, 1000, 100);\n        Table c = statTable(\"c\", new String[]{\"id\", \"d_id\"}, 100, 100, 10);\n        Table d = statTable(\"d\", new String[]{\"id\"}, 10, 10);\n        List<Table> ts = Arrays.asList(a, b, c, d);\n        List<JoinPred> ps = Arrays.asList(\n                new JoinPred(0, \"b_id\", 1, \"id\"),\n                new JoinPred(1, \"c_id\", 2, \"id\"),\n                new JoinPred(2, \"d_id\", 3, \"id\"));\n        Optimizer opt = new Optimizer(ts, ps);\n        PlanNode plan = opt.bestPlan();\n        // 小表一侧先连：最内层 c⋈d，再 b，再 a\n        TestFramework.eq(plan.rounded(), 100000L, \"根估计行数\");\n        TestFramework.check(plan.left.tableIdx == 0 || plan.right.tableIdx == 0\n                || containsScan(plan, 0), \"计划含 a 扫描\");\n        // 最优计划最内层必须是 c-d 连接（估计 100 行，代价最低起点）\n        String canon = plan.canonical(ts);\n        TestFramework.check(canon.startsWith(\"J\"), \"根为连接节点\");\n        TestFramework.approx(plan.cost, 203310.0, 1e-9, \"总代价与手算一致\");\n    }\n\n    private static boolean containsScan(PlanNode n, int t) {\n        if (n.isLeaf()) return n.tableIdx == t;\n        return containsScan(n.left, t) || containsScan(n.right, t);\n    }\n\n    static void dpMatchesExhaustiveEnumeration() {\n        // 多张随机风格查询（链、星、环、断开），DP 最优代价必须等于穷举最小代价\n        int[][][] graphCases = {\n                {{0, 1}, {1, 2}, {2, 3}},                       // 链 4\n                {{0, 1}, {0, 2}, {0, 3}},                       // 星 4\n                {{0, 1}, {1, 2}, {2, 0}, {2, 3}},               // 环+尾 4\n                {{0, 1}, {2, 3}},                               // 断开 4\n                {{0, 1}, {0, 2}, {0, 3}, {0, 4}, {1, 5}},       // 6 表\n                {},                                              // 全笛卡尔 4\n        };\n        int[] sizes = {4, 4, 4, 4, 6, 4};\n        long seed = 42;\n        for (int ci = 0; ci < graphCases.length; ci++) {\n            int n = sizes[ci];\n            List<Table> ts = new ArrayList<>();\n            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {\n                // 伪随机行数与 NDV，避免退化\n                seed = (seed * 1103515245 + 12345) & 0x7fffffff;\n                long rows = 10 + seed % 5000;\n                long ndv = 1 + seed % rows;\n                List<String> cols = new ArrayList<>();\n                List<Long> nd = new ArrayList<>();\n                cols.add(\"id\"); nd.add(rows);\n                for (int[] e : graphCases[ci]) {\n                    if (e[0] == i || e[1] == i) {\n                        int other = e[0] == i ? e[1] : e[0];\n                        String col = \"fk\" + other;\n                        cols.add(col);\n                        seed = (seed * 1103515245 + 12345) & 0x7fffffff;\n                        nd.add(1 + seed % Math.max(1, rows));\n                    }\n                }\n                Table t = statTable(\"t\" + i, cols.toArray(new String[0]),\n                        rows, nd.stream().mapToLong(Long::longValue).toArray());\n                ts.add(t);\n            }\n            List<JoinPred> ps = new ArrayList<>();\n            for (int[] e : graphCases[ci]) {\n                int x = e[0], y = e[1];\n                String cx = \"fk\" + y, cy = \"id\";\n                ps.add(new JoinPred(x, cx, y, cy));\n            }\n            Optimizer opt = new Optimizer(ts, ps);\n            Enumerator en = new Enumerator(ts, ps);\n            Enumerator.Report rep = en.fullReport();\n            TestFramework.approx(opt.bestPlan().cost, rep.minCost, 1e-6,\n                    \"case \" + ci + \" DP 代价 == 穷举最小\");\n            TestFramework.check(rep.totalTrees == rep.expectedTreeCount,\n                    \"case \" + ci + \" 穷举树数 \" + rep.totalTrees + \" == 精确公式 \" + rep.expectedTreeCount);\n        }\n    }\n\n    static void legalTreeCountMatchesFormula() {\n        // 无边 n 表：每个分量单表，合法树数 = (2n-2)!/(n-1)!，n=1..6\n        long[] expected = {1, 2, 12, 120, 1680, 30240};\n        for (int n = 1; n <= 6; n++) {\n            List<Table> ts = new ArrayList<>();\n            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) ts.add(statTable(\"t\" + i, new String[]{\"id\"}, 10, 10));\n            Enumerator en = new Enumerator(ts, new ArrayList<>());\n            Enumerator.Report rep = en.fullReport();\n            TestFramework.eq((long) rep.totalTrees, expected[n - 1],\n                    n + \" 表无边时合法树数\");\n            TestFramework.eq(rep.expectedTreeCount, expected[n - 1],\n                    n + \" 表精确计数公式\");\n        }\n        // 4 表链（连通）同样为 120\n        List<Table> ts = new ArrayList<>();\n        for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) ts.add(statTable(\"t\" + i, new String[]{\"id\"}, 10, 10));\n        List<JoinPred> ps = Arrays.asList(\n                new JoinPred(0, \"id\", 1, \"id\"),\n                new JoinPred(1, \"id\", 2, \"id\"),\n                new JoinPred(2, \"id\", 3, \"id\"));\n        Enumerator.Report rep = new Enumerator(ts, ps).fullReport();\n        TestFramework.eq((long) rep.totalTrees, 120L, \"4 表连通链也是 120 棵\");\n    }\n\n    // ---------- 5. 断开图与笛卡尔积 ----------\n\n    static void disconnectedGraphMarksCartesianAndSemantics() {\n        // {ab} 与 {c}：ab 各 3 行连完 3 行，再与 c(2 行) 积 = 6\n        String req = \"{\\\"tables\\\":[\"\n                + \"{\\\"name\\\":\\\"a\\\",\\\"columns\\\":[\\\"id\\\",\\\"b_id\\\"],\\\"rows\\\":[[1,1],[2,1],[3,2]]},\"\n                + \"{\\\"name\\\":\\\"b\\\",\\\"columns\\\":[\\\"id\\\"],\\\"rows\\\":[[1],[2]]},\"\n                + \"{\\\"name\\\":\\\"c\\\",\\\"columns\\\":[\\\"n\\\"],\\\"rows\\\":[[10],[20]]}\"\n                + \"],\\\"joins\\\":[[\\\"a\\\",\\\"b_id\\\",\\\"b\\\",\\\"id\\\"]]}\";\n        List<String> w = new ArrayList<>();\n        List<Table> ts = TestFramework.tables(req, w);\n        List<JoinPred> ps = TestFramework.preds(req, ts, w);\n        Optimizer opt = new Optimizer(ts, ps);\n        TestFramework.eq(opt.connectedComponents().size(), 2, \"两个连通分量\");\n        TestFramework.check(Optimizer.containsCartesian(opt.bestPlan()), \"计划含笛卡尔积标记\");\n        Rel r = new Executor(ts).execute(opt.bestPlan());\n        TestFramework.eq((long) r.rows.size(), 6L, \"结果行数 3×2=6\");\n        // 语义与顺序无关：手工强制另一种笛卡尔顺序 (a ⋈ c) ⋈ b 也应为 6 行（同样行多重集）\n        Map<String, Object> forced = TestFramework.obj(req.replace(\"]}\", \"]}\"));\n        // 用穷举验证所有合法计划实际行数都相同\n        for (PlanNode p : new Enumerator(ts, ps).enumerate(0b111)) {\n            Rel rr = new Executor(ts).execute(p);\n            TestFramework.eq((long) rr.rows.size(), 6L, \"每种合法顺序结果均为 6 行\");\n        }\n    }\n\n    // ---------- 6. 执行器 ----------\n\n    static void executorHashJoinSemantics() {\n        String req = \"{\\\"tables\\\":[\"\n                + \"{\\\"name\\\":\\\"a\\\",\\\"columns\\\":[\\\"k\\\",\\\"x\\\"],\\\"rows\\\":[[1,\\\"a\\\"],[2,\\\"b\\\"],[2,\\\"c\\\"]]},\"\n                + \"{\\\"name\\\":\\\"b\\\",\\\"columns\\\":[\\\"k\\\",\\\"y\\\"],\\\"rows\\\":[[2,\\\"B\\\"],[3,\\\"C\\\"]]}\"\n                + \"],\\\"joins\\\":[[\\\"a\\\",\\\"k\\\",\\\"b\\\",\\\"k\\\"]]}\";\n        List<String> w = new ArrayList<>();\n        List<Table> ts = TestFramework.tables(req, w);\n        List<JoinPred> ps = TestFramework.preds(req, ts, w);\n        Rel r = new Executor(ts).execute(new Optimizer(ts, ps).bestPlan());\n        // a 中 k=2 有两行，b 中 k=2 一行 => 2 条\n        TestFramework.eq((long) r.rows.size(), 2L, \"一对多哈希连接行数\");\n        TestFramework.eq(r.columns, Arrays.asList(\"a.k\", \"a.x\", \"b.k\", \"b.y\"), \"输出列顺序\");\n        TestFramework.eq(r.rows.get(0).get(1), \"b\", \"连接值正确\");\n        TestFramework.eq(r.rows.get(1).get(1), \"c\", \"连接值正确\");\n    }\n\n    static void executorMultiPredicateJoin() {\n        String req = \"{\\\"tables\\\":[\"\n                + \"{\\\"name\\\":\\\"a\\\",\\\"columns\\\":[\\\"k1\\\",\\\"k2\\\"],\\\"rows\\\":[[1,9],[1,8],[2,9]]},\"\n                + \"{\\\"name\\\":\\\"b\\\",\\\"columns\\\":[\\\"k1\\\",\\\"k2\\\"],\\\"rows\\\":[[1,9],[2,9]]}\"\n                + \"],\\\"joins\\\":[[\\\"a\\\",\\\"k1\\\",\\\"b\\\",\\\"k1\\\"],[\\\"a\\\",\\\"k2\\\",\\\"b\\\",\\\"k2\\\"]]}\";\n        List<String> w = new ArrayList<>();\n        List<Table> ts = TestFramework.tables(req, w);\n        List<JoinPred> ps = TestFramework.preds(req, ts, w);\n        Rel r = new Executor(ts).execute(new Optimizer(ts, ps).bestPlan());\n        // 只有 (1,9)=(1,9) 与 (2,9)=(2,9) 两条复合键匹配\n        TestFramework.eq((long) r.rows.size(), 2L, \"复合键双谓词连接\");\n    }\n\n    static void nullKeysDoNotMatch() {\n        String req = \"{\\\"tables\\\":[\"\n                + \"{\\\"name\\\":\\\"a\\\",\\\"columns\\\":[\\\"k\\\"],\\\"rows\\\":[[1],[null]]},\"\n                + \"{\\\"name\\\":\\\"b\\\",\\\"columns\\\":[\\\"k\\\"],\\\"rows\\\":[[1],[null]]}\"\n                + \"],\\\"joins\\\":[[\\\"a\\\",\\\"k\\\",\\\"b\\\",\\\"k\\\"]]}\";\n        List<String> w = new ArrayList<>();\n        List<Table> ts = TestFramework.tables(req, w);\n        List<JoinPred> ps = TestFramework.preds(req, ts, w);\n        Rel r = new Executor(ts).execute(new Optimizer(ts, ps).bestPlan());\n        TestFramework.eq((long) r.rows.size(), 1L, \"NULL 不与 NULL 匹配（SQL 语义），只剩 1=1\");\n    }\n\n    static void numericStringCanonicalization() {\n        // 整数 1 与浮点 1.0 应匹配；字符串 \"1\" 不与数字 1 匹配\n        String req = \"{\\\"tables\\\":[\"\n                + \"{\\\"name\\\":\\\"a\\\",\\\"columns\\\":[\\\"k\\\"],\\\"rows\\\":[[1],[\\\"1\\\"]]},\"\n                + \"{\\\"name\\\":\\\"b\\\",\\\"columns\\\":[\\\"k\\\"],\\\"rows\\\":[[1.0]]}\"\n                + \"],\\\"joins\\\":[[\\\"a\\\",\\\"k\\\",\\\"b\\\",\\\"k\\\"]]}\";\n        List<String> w = new ArrayList<>();\n        List<Table> ts = TestFramework.tables(req, w);\n        List<JoinPred> ps = TestFramework.preds(req, ts, w);\n        Rel r = new Executor(ts).execute(new Optimizer(ts, ps).bestPlan());\n        TestFramework.eq((long) r.rows.size(), 1L, \"1 与 1.0 匹配，字符串不匹配\");\n    }\n\n    // ---------- 7. 倾斜 ----------\n\n    static void skewedStatsEstimateVsActual() {\n        // 两张 10 行表：k 分布 9 个 1 + 1 个 2；NDV=2。\n        // 均匀估计 = 100/2 = 50；实际 = 9*9 + 1*1 = 82\n        String req = \"{\\\"tables\\\":[\"\n                + \"{\\\"name\\\":\\\"a\\\",\\\"columns\\\":[\\\"k\\\"],\\\"rows\\\":[[1],[1],[1],[1],[1],[1],[1],[1],[1],[2]]},\"\n                + TestFramework.check(v.equals(v2), \"JSON 往返后结构应一致\");\n    }\n\n    static void jsonHandlesNumbersStringsNullEscape() {\n        Map<String, Object> m = TestFramework.check(Json.parse(pretty).equals(m), \"转义后往返一致\");\n    }\n\n    // ---------- 2. 表统计 ----------\n\n    static void tableNdvComputedFromDataAndCapped() {\n        List<String> w = new List<Table> ts = TestFramework.tables(req, w);\n        Table t = ts.get(0);\n        TestFramework.eq(t.rowCount, 3L, \"实际行数\");\n        TestFramework.eq(t.ndv.get(\"k\"), 2L, \"k 的 NDV\");\n        TestFramework.eq(t.ndv.get(\"v\"), 3L, \"v 的 NDV\");\n\n        List<String> w2 = new ArrayList<>();\n        String req2 = \"{\\\"tables\\\":[{\\\"name\\\":\\\"t\\\",\\\"columns\\\":[\\\"k\\\"],\\\"rowCount\\\":5,\\\"ndv\\\":{\\\"k\\\":9}}]}\";\n        Table t2 = TestFramework.tables(req2, w2).get(0);\n        TestFramework.eq(t2.ndv.get(\"k\"), 5L, \"NDV 超过行数应截断\");\n        TestFramework.check(!w2.isEmpty(), \"截断应产生告警\");\n        TestFramework.check(t2.statsOnly, \"无 rows 为仅统计表\");\n    }\n\n    // ---------- 3. 估计 ----------\n\n    /** 构造仅统计表。 */\n    private static List<Table> statsTables(String names, long[] rows, long[]... ndvs) {\n        List<String> w = new ArrayList<>();\n        StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder(\"{\\\"tables\\\":[\");\n        String[] nm = names.split(\",\");\n        for (int i = 0; i < nm.length; i++) {\n            if (i > 0) sb.append(',');\n            sb.append(\"{\\\"name\\\":\\\"\").append(nm[i]).append(\"\\\",\\\"columns\\\":[\\\"id\\\"]\");\n            if (i < ndvs.length) sb.append(\",\\\"rowCount\\\":\").append(rows[i])\n                    .append(\",\\\"ndv\\\":{\\\"id\\\":\").append(ndvs[i][0]).append(\"}\");\n            sb.append('}');\n        }\n        sb.append(\"]}\");\n        return TestFramework.tables(sb.toString(), w);\n    }\n\n    /** 带指定列名/NDV 的统计表。 */\n    private static Table statTable(String name, String[] cols, long rows, long... colNdv) {\n        List<String> w = new ArrayList<>();\n        StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder(\"{\\\"name\\\":\\\"\").append(name)\n                .append(\"\\\",\\\"columns\\\":[\");\n        for (int i = 0; i < cols.length; i++) {\n            if (i > 0) sb.append(',');\n            sb.append('\"').append(cols[i]).append('\"');\n        }\n        sb.append(\"],\\\"rowCount\\\":\").append(rows).append(\",\\\"ndv\\\":{\");\n        for (int i = 0; i < cols.length; i++) {\n            if (i > 0) sb.append(',');\n            sb.append('\"').append(cols[i]).append(\"\\\":\").append(colNdv[i]);\n        }\n        sb.append(\"}}\");\n        return Table.fromJson(TestFramework.obj(sb.toString()), w);\n    }\n\n    static void cardinalityEstimationTextbookFormula() {\n        // a(1000, ndv id=1000, b_id=100) ⋈ b(100, ndv id=100) => 1000\n        Table a = statTable(\"a\", new String[]{\"id\", \"b_id\"}, 1000, 1000, 100);\n        Table b = statTable(\"b\", new String[]{\"id\"}, 100, 100);\n        List<Table> ts = Arrays.asList(a, b);\n        List<JoinPred> ps = Arrays.asList(new JoinPred(0, \"b_id\", 1, \"id\"));\n        Estimator est = new Estimator(ts, ps);\n        Stats s = est.estimate(0b11);\n        TestFramework.approx(s.rows, 1000.0, 1e-9, \"两表估计行数 = |a||b|/max(100,100)\");\n        TestFramework.eq(s.ndv.get(\"a.b_id\"), 100L, \"结果列 NDV 不超行数\");\n    }\n\n    static void estimationIsOrderIndependent() {\n        // 3 表链：同一子集的估计无论怎么切分，joinRows 复算结果必须一致\n        Table a = statTable(\"a\", new String[]{\"id\", \"b_id\"}, 100000, 100000, 1000);\n        Table b = statTable(\"b\", new String[]{\"id\", \"c_id\"}, 1000, 1000, 100);\n        Table c = statTable(\"c\", new String[]{\"id\"}, 100, 100);\n        List<Table> ts = Arrays.asList(a, b, c);\n        List<JoinPred> ps = Arrays.asList(\n                new JoinPred(0, \"b_id\", 1, \"id\"),\n                new JoinPred(1, \"c_id\", 2, \"id\"));\n        Estimator est = new Estimator(ts, ps);\n\n        double whole = est.estimate(0b111).rows;\n        // (a⋈b)⋈c\n        double ab = est.estimate(0b011).rows;\n        double v1 = est.joinRows(new Stats(ab, new LinkedHashMap<>()), est.estimate(0b100),\n                0b011, 0b100, est.crossingPreds(0b011, 0b100));\n        // (b⋈c)⋈a\n        double bc = est.estimate(0b110).rows;\n        double v2 = est.joinRows(new Stats(bc, new LinkedHashMap<>()), est.estimate(0b001),\n                0b110, 0b001, est.crossingPreds(0b110, 0b001));\n        TestFramework.approx(v1, whole, 1e-6, \"(ab)c 与整体估计一致\");\n        TestFramework.approx(v2, whole, 1e-6, \"a(bc) 与整体估计一致\");\n        TestFramework.approx(whole, 100000.0, 1e-6, \"链三表最终估计=100000\");\n    }\n\n    // ---------- 4. DP 与穷举 ----------\n\n    static void dpPicksMinCostPlan_chain() {\n        Table a = statTable(\"a\", new String[]{\"id\", \"b_id\"}, 100000, 100000, 1000);\n        Table b = statTable(\"b\", new String[]{\"id\", \"c_id\"}, 1000, 1000, 100);\n        Table c = statTable(\"c\", new String[]{\"id\", \"d_id\"}, 100, 100, 10);\n        Table d = statTable(\"d\", new String[]{\"id\"}, 10, 10);\n        List<Table> ts = Arrays.asList(a, b, c, d);\n        List<JoinPred> ps = Arrays.asList(\n                new JoinPred(0, \"b_id\", 1, \"id\"),\n                new JoinPred(1, \"c_id\", 2, \"id\"),\n                new JoinPred(2, \"d_id\", 3, \"id\"));\n        Optimizer opt = new Optimizer(ts, ps);\n        PlanNode plan = opt.bestPlan();\n        // 小表一侧先连：最内层 c⋈d，再 b，再 a\n        TestFramework.eq(plan.rounded(), 100000L, \"根估计行数\");\n        TestFramework.check(plan.left.tableIdx == 0 || plan.right.tableIdx == 0\n                || containsScan(plan, 0), \"计划含 a 扫描\");\n        // 最优计划最内层必须是 c-d 连接（估计 100 行，代价最低起点）\n        String canon = plan.canonical(ts);\n        TestFramework.check(canon.startsWith(\"J\"), \"根为连接节点\");\n        TestFramework.approx(plan.cost, 203310.0, 1e-9, \"总代价与手算一致\");\n    }\n\n    private static boolean containsScan(PlanNode n, int t) {\n        if (n.isLeaf()) return n.tableIdx == t;\n        return containsScan(n.left, t) || containsScan(n.right, t);\n    }\n\n    static void dpMatchesExhaustiveEnumeration() {\n        // 多张随机风格查询（链、星、环、断开），DP 最优代价必须等于穷举最小代价\n        int[][][] graphCases = {\n                {{0, 1}, {1, 2}, {2, 3}},                       // 链 4\n                {{0, 1}, {0, 2}, {0, 3}},                       // 星 4\n                {{0, 1}, {1, 2}, {2, 0}, {2, 3}},               // 环+尾 4\n                {{0, 1}, {2, 3}},                               // 断开 4\n                {{0, 1}, {0, 2}, {0, 3}, {0, 4}, {1, 5}},       // 6 表\n                {},                                              // 全笛卡尔 4\n        };\n        int[] sizes = {4, 4, 4, 4, 6, 4};\n        long seed = 42;\n        for (int ci = 0; ci < graphCases.length; ci++) {\n            int n = sizes[ci];\n            List<Table> ts = new ArrayList<>();\n            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {\n                // 伪随机行数与 NDV，避免退化\n                seed = (seed * 1103515245 + 12345) & 0x7fffffff;\n                long rows = 10 + seed % 5000;\n                long ndv = 1 + seed % rows;\n                List<String> cols = new ArrayList<>();\n                List<Long> nd = new ArrayList<>();\n                cols.add(\"id\"); nd.add(rows);\n                for (int[] e : graphCases[ci]) {\n                    if (e[0] == i || e[1] == i) {\n                        int other = e[0] == i ? e[1] : e[0];\n                        String col = \"fk\" + other;\n                        cols.add(col);\n                        seed = (seed * 1103515245 + 12345) & 0x7fffffff;\n                        nd.add(1 + seed % Math.max(1, rows));\n                    }\n                }\n                Table t = statTable(\"t\" + i, cols.toArray(new String[0]),\n                        rows, nd.stream().mapToLong(Long::longValue).toArray());\n                ts.add(t);\n            }\n            List<JoinPred> ps = new ArrayList<>();\n            for (int[] e : graphCases[ci]) {\n                int x = e[0], y = e[1];\n                String cx = \"fk\" + y, cy = \"id\";\n                ps.add(new JoinPred(x, cx, y, cy));\n            }\n            Optimizer opt = new Optimizer(ts, ps);\n            Enumerator en = new Enumerator(ts, ps);\n            Enumerator.Report rep = en.fullReport();\n            TestFramework.approx(opt.bestPlan().cost, rep.minCost, 1e-6,\n }\n                ndvMap.put(columns.get(i), d);\n            }\n            if (!t.statsOnly) {\n                warnings.add(\"表 \" + name + \" 未提供 ndv，已按实际数据计算不同值个数\");\n            }\n        }\n\n        // NDV 不能超过行数（0 行表 NDV 强制为 0）\n        for (String col : columns) {\n            long d = ndvMap.get(col);\n            long capped = t.rowCount == 0 ? 0 : Math.min(d, t.rowCount);\n
